import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Sum
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

open Finset

/-! # Lake inventory (SYNTHETIC survey VCS-LK-001) — review packet

SUPPLIED INFORMATION (data): per species camera labels y (all 18 videos), reference-video
calibration (hits/160, false labels/200), eDNA positive grabs k of 18 (any of 3 PCR libs),
blanks (1 positive of 16 field-blank taxon x grab cells), footprint 1260 m2 per pass of 57782.56 m2
mapped area, 2 passes.  See `mkSp` / `lakeSpecies`.

MODELLING CHOICES (not inferred; for review): (1) N=0 iff absent; prior P(N>0)=omega (table in
`lakeSpecies`, judgement, NOT from these data); N|present ~ 1/n on 1..100000 (scale-invariant,
capped). (2) camera labels = false labels (Binomial(36,phi)) + true encounters (Binomial(2N,q)),
phi, d from calibration by grid Bayes with flat prior; q = coverFrac*tau*d, tau = unidentified
field/reference transfer factor, reported as a scenario. (3) eDNA: grab positives patterned
Bernoulli with rate theta~flat if present, contamination f~grid posterior from blanks if absent.
(4) species independent given tau; non-panel fish excluded; sonar unused; mapped areas exact.
PROVED: normalisation/likelihood laws, presence formula, posterior laws, conv law of total, additive
mean/variance (`lake_answer`).  Numbers are NOT proved in Lean (see report.txt). -/

/-- Binomial pmf: number of successes in `m` independent trials of success probability `p`. -/
def binomPmf (m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ := (m.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (m - k)

theorem binomPmf_nonneg (m : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ binomPmf m p k := by
  unfold binomPmf
  have : 0 ≤ 1 - p := by linarith
  positivity

theorem binomPmf_sum (m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ∑ k ∈ range (m + 1), binomPmf m p k = 1 := by
  have h := add_pow p (1 - p) m
  have h2 : (p + (1 - p)) ^ m = 1 := by simp
  rw [h2] at h
  rw [h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  unfold binomPmf; ring

/-- `L` is a probability law on `{0,…,M}` (values beyond `M` are never used). -/
structure IsLaw (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ w n
  sum_one : ∑ n ∈ range (M + 1), w n = 1

/-- Expectation of `g` under `w` on `{0,…,M}`. -/
def E (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range (M + 1), w n * g n
def mean (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := E M w (fun n => (n : ℝ))
def var (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := E M w (fun n => ((n : ℝ) - mean M w) ^ 2)

/-- Law of `X + Y` for independent `X ~ a` on `{0..M1}` and `Y ~ b` on `{0..M2}`. -/
def conv (M1 M2 : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ := fun t =>
  ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), if i + j = t then a i * b j else 0

theorem conv_E (M1 M2 : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    E (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) g =
      ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * g (i + j) := by
  unfold E conv
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => ?_)
  have hm : i + j ∈ range (M1 + M2 + 1) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi hj ⊢; omega
  simp [ite_mul, hm]

theorem conv_isLaw {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (hb : IsLaw M2 b) :
    IsLaw (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) := by
  constructor
  · intro t
    unfold conv
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => ?_))
    split_ifs
    · exact mul_nonneg (ha.nonneg i) (hb.nonneg j)
    · exact le_refl _
  · have h := conv_E M1 M2 a b (fun _ => 1)
    unfold E at h
    simp only [mul_one] at h
    rw [h]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [hb.sum_one]
    simp [ha.sum_one]

/-- Summing out the second factor of a product law. -/
theorem sum_prod_left {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hb : IsLaw M2 b) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * F i
      = ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * F i := by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  have : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * F i = (a i * F i) * ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_); ring
  rw [this, hb.sum_one, mul_one]

theorem sum_prod_right {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * F j
      = ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * F j := by
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have : ∀ j, ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * b j * F j = (b j * F j) * ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i := by
    intro j; rw [Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_); ring
  simp only [this, ha.sum_one, mul_one]

theorem mean_conv {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (hb : IsLaw M2 b) :
    mean (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) = mean M1 a + mean M2 b := by
  unfold mean
  rw [conv_E]
  have h : ∀ i j : ℕ, a i * b j * ((((i + j : ℕ)) : ℝ)) =
      a i * b j * (i : ℝ) + a i * b j * (j : ℝ) := by intro i j; push_cast; ring
  simp only [h, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [sum_prod_left hb (fun i => (i : ℝ)), sum_prod_right ha (fun j => (j : ℝ))]
  rfl

theorem var_conv {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (hb : IsLaw M2 b) :
    var (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) = var M1 a + var M2 b := by
  unfold var
  rw [mean_conv ha hb, conv_E]
  set ma := mean M1 a
  set mb := mean M2 b
  have hca : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma) = 0 := by
    have : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma) = mean M1 a - ma * 1 := by
      simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [← ha.sum_one]; simp [mean, E, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
    rw [this]; simp [ma]
  have hcb : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb) = 0 := by
    have : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb) = mean M2 b - mb * 1 := by
      simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [← hb.sum_one]; simp [mean, E, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
    rw [this]; simp [mb]
  have h : ∀ i j : ℕ, a i * b j * ((((i + j : ℕ)) : ℝ) - (ma + mb)) ^ 2 =
      a i * b j * ((i : ℝ) - ma) ^ 2 + a i * b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb) ^ 2
        + 2 * ((a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) * (b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb))) := by
    intro i j; push_cast; ring
  simp only [h, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [sum_prod_left hb (fun i => ((i : ℝ) - ma) ^ 2), sum_prod_right ha (fun j => ((j : ℝ) - mb) ^ 2)]
  have hx : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1),
      2 * ((a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) * (b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb))) = 0 := by
    have : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1),
        2 * ((a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) * (b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb)))
        = 2 * ((∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) *
            (∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb))) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [this, hca]; simp
  rw [hx]
  simp [var, E, ma, mb]

/-! ### Parameter grids (finite discretisation of nuisance parameters) -/

/-- Discrete prior/posterior over a probability-valued nuisance parameter: weights `w i`, values `x i`, `i < K`. -/
structure Grid where
  K : ℕ
  w : ℕ → ℝ
  x : ℕ → ℝ

/-- Expectation of `f(parameter)` over the grid. -/
def gridAvg (g : Grid) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ range g.K, g.w i * f (g.x i)

/-- Probability weights, parameters in the closed unit interval. -/
structure GridOk (g : Grid) : Prop where
  w_nonneg : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ g.w i
  w_sum : ∑ i ∈ range g.K, g.w i = 1
  x_mem : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ g.x i ∧ g.x i ≤ 1

/-- Strictly positive weights and parameters strictly inside (0,1); at least one grid point. -/
structure GridPos (g : Grid) : Prop where
  K_pos : 0 < g.K
  w_pos : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 < g.w i
  x_in : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 < g.x i ∧ g.x i < 1

theorem gridAvg_nonneg (g : Grid) (hw : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ g.w i) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ f (g.x i)) : 0 ≤ (gridAvg g) f :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => mul_nonneg (hw i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) (hf i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))

theorem gridAvg_pos (g : Grid) (hp : (GridPos g)) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 < f (g.x i)) : 0 < (gridAvg g) f :=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun i hi => mul_pos (hp.w_pos i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) (hf i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))
    ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr hp.K_pos⟩

/-- A mixture of laws indexed by a grid is a law. -/
theorem mix_isLaw {g : Grid} (hg : (GridOk g)) {M : ℕ} {L : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ i, i < g.K → IsLaw M (L (g.x i))) : IsLaw M (fun k => (gridAvg g) (fun p => L p k)) := by
  constructor
  · intro k
    exact (gridAvg_nonneg g) hg.w_nonneg (fun i hi => (hL i hi).nonneg k)
  · unfold gridAvg
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have : ∀ i ∈ range g.K, ∑ k ∈ range (M + 1), g.w i * L (g.x i) k = g.w i := by
      intro i hi
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, (hL i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).sum_one, mul_one]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this]
    exact hg.w_sum

theorem binomPmf_isLaw (m : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) : IsLaw m (binomPmf m p) :=
  ⟨binomPmf_nonneg m h0 h1, binomPmf_sum m p⟩

theorem binomPmf_pos (m : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < p) (h1 : p < 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) :
    0 < binomPmf m p k := by
  unfold binomPmf
  have : 0 < 1 - p := by linarith
  have := Nat.choose_pos hk
  positivity

/-- Calibration step: grid posterior of a success probability after `hits` successes in `trials`
trials, from a flat prior on the midpoints `(i+1/2)/K` (Bayes' rule on a grid). -/
noncomputable def calGrid (K hits trials : ℕ) : Grid where
  K := K
  w := fun i => (((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits * (1 - ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) /
    ∑ j ∈ range K, (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits * (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits)
  x := fun i => ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K

/-- Flat grid (no calibration information). -/
noncomputable def flatGrid (K : ℕ) : Grid where
  K := K
  w := fun _ => 1 / K
  x := fun i => ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K

theorem grid_x_in (K : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < K) :
    0 < ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K ∧ ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K < 1 := by
  have hK : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hi)
  have hi' : (i : ℝ) + 1 ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hi
  constructor
  · positivity
  · rw [div_lt_one hK]; linarith

theorem grid_x_in' (K : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K ∧
    (i < K → ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K ≤ 1) := by
  refine ⟨by positivity, fun hi => (grid_x_in K hi).2.le⟩

theorem calGrid_pos (K hits trials : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridPos (calGrid K hits trials)) := by
  have hterm : ∀ j, j < K → 0 < (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits *
      (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) := by
    intro j hj
    have h := grid_x_in K hj
    have : 0 < 1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K := by linarith [h.2]
    have := h.1
    positivity
  have hS : 0 < ∑ j ∈ range K, (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits *
      (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun j hj => hterm j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr hK⟩
  refine ⟨hK, fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi => grid_x_in K hi⟩
  exact div_pos (hterm i hi) hS

theorem flatGrid_pos (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridPos (flatGrid K)) := by
  refine ⟨hK, fun i _ => ?_, fun i hi => grid_x_in K hi⟩
  have : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  show 0 < 1 / (K : ℝ)
  positivity

theorem calGrid_sum (K hits trials : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (calGrid K hits trials).K, (calGrid K hits trials).w i = 1 := by
  have hp := calGrid_pos K hits trials hK
  show ∑ i ∈ range K, _ = 1
  have hS : 0 < ∑ j ∈ range K, (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits *
      (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) := by
    refine Finset.sum_pos (fun j hj => ?_) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr hK⟩
    have h := grid_x_in K (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    have : 0 < 1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K := by linarith [h.2]
    have := h.1
    positivity
  show ∑ i ∈ range K, (_ / _) = 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self hS.ne'

theorem calGrid_ok (K hits trials : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridOk (calGrid K hits trials)) := by
  have hp := calGrid_pos K hits trials hK
  exact ⟨fun i hi => (hp.w_pos i hi).le, calGrid_sum K hits trials hK,
    fun i hi => ⟨(hp.x_in i hi).1.le, (hp.x_in i hi).2.le⟩⟩

theorem flatGrid_ok (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridOk (flatGrid K)) := by
  have hp := flatGrid_pos K hK
  refine ⟨fun i hi => (hp.w_pos i hi).le, ?_, fun i hi => ⟨(hp.x_in i hi).1.le, (hp.x_in i hi).2.le⟩⟩
  show ∑ i ∈ range K, (1 / (K : ℝ)) = 1
  have : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hK.ne'
  simp [this]

/-! ### Species model -/

/-- Harmonic normaliser of the scale-invariant (1/n) prior on `{1,…,M}`. -/
noncomputable def harm (M : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ range M, 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)

/-- Everything specific to one species: prior, camera model, eDNA model, observed data. -/
structure Sp where
  M : ℕ        -- carrying-capacity cap on the number of individuals
  omega : ℝ    -- prior probability that the species is present (N > 0)
  y : ℕ        -- observed camera labels of this species (all 18 videos, both size bins)
  m : ℕ        -- number of fish-free-video-like opportunities for a false label (18 videos x 2 bins)
  c : ℕ        -- number of independent passes (each fish can be encountered once per pass)
  gF : Grid    -- per-opportunity false-label probability
  gQ : Grid    -- per-fish, per-pass probability of a correctly labelled encounter
  k : ℕ        -- water grabs with species-positive eDNA
  nG : ℕ       -- total water grabs
  gC : Grid    -- per-grab false-positive (contamination) probability when absent
  gT : Grid    -- per-grab detection probability when present

/-- Prior law of `N`: `P(N=0)=1-ω`; given presence `P(N=n) ∝ 1/n` on `1..M`. -/
noncomputable def spPrior (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n = 0 then 1 - s.omega else s.omega * (1 / (n : ℝ)) / harm s.M

/-- Law of the number of false labels. -/
def spPF (s : Sp) : ℕ → ℝ := fun f => (gridAvg s.gF) (fun p => binomPmf s.m p f)
/-- Law of the number of true encounters given `N = n`. -/
def spPT (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => (gridAvg s.gQ) (fun q => binomPmf (s.c * n) q t)
/-- Likelihood of observing `y` camera labels given `N = n`: false labels + true encounters. -/
def spCamLik (s : Sp) (n y : ℕ) : ℝ := conv s.m (s.c * n) (spPF s) ((spPT s) n) y

/-- Probability of the observed eDNA grab pattern given absent / present. -/
def pattern (k nG : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ := p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (nG - k)
noncomputable def spEdnaLik (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n = 0 then (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) else (gridAvg s.gT) (pattern s.k s.nG)

/-- Unnormalised posterior and evidence. -/
noncomputable def spUnnorm (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (spPrior s) n * (spCamLik s) n s.y * (spEdnaLik s) n
noncomputable def spZ (s : Sp) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range (s.M + 1), (spUnnorm s) n
/-- Posterior law of the number of individuals (Bayes' rule). -/
noncomputable def spPost (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (spUnnorm s) n / (spZ s)

/-- Presence means at least one living individual. -/
noncomputable def spPresence (s : Sp) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range (s.M + 1), if 0 < n then (spPost s) n else 0

structure SpValid (s : Sp) : Prop where
  M_pos : 1 ≤ s.M
  omega_pos : 0 < s.omega
  omega_lt : s.omega < 1
  gF : (GridPos s.gF)
  gQ : (GridPos s.gQ)
  gC : (GridPos s.gC)
  gT : (GridPos s.gT)
  gFo : (GridOk s.gF)
  gQo : (GridOk s.gQ)
  gCo : (GridOk s.gC)
  gTo : (GridOk s.gT)
  y_le : s.y ≤ s.c * s.M
  nG_ge : s.k ≤ s.nG

theorem harm_pos {M : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ M) : 0 < harm M := by
  unfold harm
  refine Finset.sum_pos (fun k _ => by positivity) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr h⟩

theorem prior_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : IsLaw s.M (spPrior s) := by
  have hH := harm_pos h.M_pos
  constructor
  · intro n
    unfold spPrior
    split_ifs
    · linarith [h.omega_lt]
    · have := h.omega_pos; positivity
  · rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [spPrior]
    simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, if_true]
    have : ∑ i ∈ range s.M, s.omega * (1 / (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) / harm s.M = s.omega := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have : ∑ i ∈ range s.M, (1 / (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) = harm s.M := by
        unfold harm; push_cast; rfl
      rw [this]; field_simp
    rw [this]; ring

theorem pF_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : IsLaw s.m (spPF s) :=
  mix_isLaw h.gFo (fun i hi => binomPmf_isLaw s.m (h.gFo.x_mem i hi).1 (h.gFo.x_mem i hi).2)

theorem pT_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : IsLaw (s.c * n) ((spPT s) n) :=
  mix_isLaw h.gQo (fun i hi => binomPmf_isLaw (s.c * n) (h.gQo.x_mem i hi).1 (h.gQo.x_mem i hi).2)

/-- The camera likelihood is a genuine probability law for the data `y` given `N = n`. -/
theorem camLik_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) :
    IsLaw (s.m + s.c * n) (fun y => (spCamLik s) n y) :=
  conv_isLaw (pF_isLaw h) (pT_isLaw h n)

theorem ednaLik_nonneg {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (spEdnaLik s) n := by
  unfold spEdnaLik
  have key : ∀ g : Grid, (GridOk g) → 0 ≤ (gridAvg g) (pattern s.k s.nG) := by
    intro g hg
    refine (gridAvg_nonneg g) hg.w_nonneg (fun i hi => ?_)
    have := hg.x_mem i hi
    unfold pattern
    have : 0 ≤ 1 - g.x i := by linarith [this.2]
    have := (hg.x_mem i hi).1
    positivity
  split_ifs
  · exact key _ h.gCo
  · exact key _ h.gTo

theorem ednaLik_pos {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : 0 < (spEdnaLik s) n := by
  unfold spEdnaLik
  have key : ∀ g : Grid, (GridPos g) → 0 < (gridAvg g) (pattern s.k s.nG) := by
    intro g hg
    refine (gridAvg_pos g) hg (fun i hi => ?_)
    have := hg.x_in i hi
    unfold pattern
    have : 0 < 1 - g.x i := by linarith [this.2]
    have := (hg.x_in i hi).1
    positivity
  split_ifs
  · exact key _ h.gC
  · exact key _ h.gT

theorem unnorm_nonneg {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (spUnnorm s) n := by
  unfold spUnnorm
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ((prior_isLaw h).nonneg n) ((camLik_isLaw h n).nonneg _))
    (ednaLik_nonneg h n)

theorem conv_pos {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n)
    (ha0 : 0 < a 0) {y : ℕ} (hy : y ≤ M2) (hby : 0 < b y) : 0 < conv M1 M2 a b y := by
  unfold conv
  have h0 : 0 ∈ range (M1 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos _)
  have hyr : y ∈ range (M2 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hy)
  have inner_nn : ∀ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1),
      (if i + j = y then a i * b j else 0) := fun i _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs; exact mul_nonneg (ha i) (hb j); exact le_refl _)
  have h1 := Finset.single_le_sum inner_nn h0
  have h2 := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => if 0 + j = y then a 0 * b j else 0)
    (fun j _ => by split_ifs; exact mul_nonneg (ha 0) (hb j); exact le_refl _) hyr
  simp only [zero_add, if_true] at h2
  have : 0 < a 0 * b y := mul_pos ha0 hby
  simp only [zero_add] at h1
  linarith

theorem camLik_pos {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : 0 < (spCamLik s) s.M s.y := by
  unfold spCamLik
  have hF0 : 0 < (spPF s) 0 := by
    refine (gridAvg_pos s.gF) h.gF (fun i hi => binomPmf_pos s.m (h.gF.x_in i hi).1 (h.gF.x_in i hi).2 (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hT : 0 < (spPT s) s.M s.y :=
    (gridAvg_pos s.gQ) h.gQ (fun i hi => binomPmf_pos _ (h.gQ.x_in i hi).1 (h.gQ.x_in i hi).2 h.y_le)
  exact conv_pos (pF_isLaw h).nonneg (pT_isLaw h s.M).nonneg hF0 h.y_le hT

/-- The data are possible under the model: the evidence is strictly positive. -/
theorem Z_pos {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : 0 < (spZ s) := by
  unfold spZ
  have hH := harm_pos h.M_pos
  refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun n _ => unnorm_nonneg h n) ⟨s.M, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self _), ?_⟩
  unfold spUnnorm spPrior
  have hM : s.M ≠ 0 := by have := h.M_pos; omega
  simp only [hM, if_false]
  have := h.omega_pos
  have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < s.M := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hM
  have := camLik_pos h
  have := ednaLik_pos h s.M
  positivity

/-- The posterior is a probability law on `{0,…,M}`. -/
theorem post_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : IsLaw s.M (spPost s) := by
  have hZ := Z_pos h
  constructor
  · intro n; exact div_nonneg (unnorm_nonneg h n) hZ.le
  · unfold spPost
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hZ.ne'

/-- Posterior probability of presence (`N > 0`) is `1 - P(N = 0 | data)`, with the explicit form of
`P(N=0 | data)`. -/
theorem presence_formula {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) :
    (spPresence s) = 1 - (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s) := by
  have hl := (post_isLaw h).sum_one
  unfold spPresence
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at hl ⊢
  simp only [Nat.succ_pos, if_true, lt_self_iff_false, if_false, add_zero] at hl ⊢
  have h0 : (spPost s) 0 = (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s) := by
    simp [spPost, spUnnorm, spPrior, spEdnaLik]
  linarith

/-- With no camera false labels possible, one labelled encounter excludes absence. -/
theorem camera_excludes_absence {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (hy : 0 < s.y)
    (hnofp : ∀ i, i < s.gF.K → s.gF.x i = 0) : (spPresence s) = 1 := by
  rw [presence_formula h]
  have hz : (spCamLik s) 0 s.y = 0 := by
    unfold spCamLik conv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hjm => ?_))
    have hj : j = 0 := by simp at hjm; omega
    split_ifs with hij
    · have hi : i ≠ 0 := by omega
      have : (spPF s) i = 0 := by
        unfold spPF gridAvg
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun l hl => ?_)
        rw [hnofp l (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)]
        simp [binomPmf, hi]
      rw [this, zero_mul]
    · rfl
  rw [hz]; simp

/-- Independence: with a product prior and a product likelihood, the joint posterior of two
species is the product of the marginal posteriors. -/
theorem joint_posterior_factorizes {M1 M2 : ℕ} {pa pb la lb : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hZa : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), pa i * la i ≠ 0) (hZb : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), pb j * lb j ≠ 0)
    (i j : ℕ) :
    (pa i * pb j * (la i * lb j)) /
        ∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pa i' * pb j' * (la i' * lb j') =
      ((pa i * la i) / ∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), pa i' * la i') *
        ((pb j * lb j) / ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pb j' * lb j') := by
  have : ∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pa i' * pb j' * (la i' * lb j') =
      (∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), pa i' * la i') * ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pb j' * lb j' := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j' _ => ?_))
    ring
  rw [this]
  field_simp

/-! ### Total population -/

/-- Law (support bound, pmf) of the total of a list of independent species counts. -/
noncomputable def totalLaw : List Sp → ℕ × (ℕ → ℝ)
  | [] => (0, fun n => if n = 0 then 1 else 0)
  | s :: ss => (s.M + (totalLaw ss).1, conv s.M (totalLaw ss).1 (spPost s) (totalLaw ss).2)

theorem totalLaw_spec : ∀ l : List Sp, (∀ s ∈ l, (SpValid s)) →
    IsLaw (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 ∧
    mean (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => mean s.M (spPost s))).sum ∧
    var (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => var s.M (spPost s))).sum
  | [], _ => by
    refine ⟨⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [totalLaw]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
    · simp [totalLaw]
    · simp [totalLaw, mean, E]
    · simp [totalLaw, var, E, mean]
  | s :: ss, hv => by
    have hs : (SpValid s) := hv s (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := totalLaw_spec ss (fun t ht => hv t (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ht))
    have hl := post_isLaw hs
    refine ⟨conv_isLaw hl h1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [totalLaw, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [mean_conv hl h1, h2]
    · simp only [totalLaw, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [var_conv hl h1, h3]

/-- **Answer.** For independent species counts whose posteriors are defined by the Bayesian model
above: each species posterior is a probability law, its presence probability is given by the
explicit formula, a labelled camera encounter excludes absence when no false labels are possible,
and the total population posterior is the convolution of the species laws, a probability law
whose mean and variance are the sums of the species means and variances. -/
theorem answer_theorem : ∀ l : List Sp, (∀ s ∈ l, (SpValid s)) →
    (∀ s ∈ l, IsLaw s.M (spPost s) ∧
      (spPresence s) = 1 - (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s)) ∧
    IsLaw (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 ∧
    mean (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => mean s.M (spPost s))).sum ∧
    var (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => var s.M (spPost s))).sum := by
  intro l hv
  exact ⟨fun s hs => ⟨post_isLaw (hv s hs), presence_formula (hv s hs)⟩, totalLaw_spec l hv⟩

/-! ### The lake: data and explicit modelling choices -/

/-- Rescale the parameters of a grid by a factor `a` (used for transfer/coverage). -/
def scaledGrid (g : Grid) (a : ℝ) : Grid where
  K := g.K
  w := g.w
  x := fun i => a * g.x i

theorem scaledGrid_pos {g : Grid} (hg : (GridPos g)) {a : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < a) (h1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (GridPos (scaledGrid g a)) := by
  refine ⟨hg.K_pos, hg.w_pos, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have := hg.x_in i hi
  show 0 < a * g.x i ∧ a * g.x i < 1
  constructor
  · exact mul_pos h0 this.1
  · nlinarith [this.1, this.2]

theorem scaledGrid_ok {g : Grid} (hg : (GridOk g)) {a : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ a) (h1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (GridOk (scaledGrid g a)) := by
  refine ⟨hg.w_nonneg, hg.w_sum, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have := hg.x_mem i hi
  show 0 ≤ a * g.x i ∧ a * g.x i ≤ 1
  constructor
  · exact mul_nonneg h0 this.1
  · nlinarith [this.1, this.2]

/-- Fraction of the mapped lake area (57 782.56 m²) covered by the 9 camera footprints (1260 m²)
of one pass. -/
noncomputable def coverFrac : ℝ := 1260 / 57782.56

theorem coverFrac_bounds : 0 < coverFrac ∧ coverFrac < 1 := by
  unfold coverFrac; constructor <;> norm_num

/-- One panel species.  `om` prior presence probability; `y` camera labels; `calHits` correct
labels out of 160 reference encounters; `fpHits` false labels in 200 fish-free reference videos;
`k` eDNA-positive grabs of 18; `tau` field/reference detectability transfer factor. -/
noncomputable def mkSp (om : ℝ) (y calHits fpHits k : ℕ) (tau : ℝ) : Sp where
  M := 100000
  omega := om
  y := y
  m := 36
  c := 2
  gF := calGrid 20 fpHits 200
  gQ := scaledGrid (calGrid 20 calHits 160) (coverFrac * tau)
  k := k
  nG := 18
  gC := calGrid 20 1 16
  gT := flatGrid 20

/-- The eight panel species, in order: perch, roach, ruffe, pike, burbot, bleak, vendace, bream. -/
noncomputable def lakeSpecies (tau : ℝ) : List Sp :=
  [ mkSp (97 / 100) 39 97 2 17 tau, mkSp (9 / 10) 26 82 2 17 tau,
    mkSp (8 / 10) 1 29 1 14 tau, mkSp (9 / 10) 1 67 6 9 tau,
    mkSp (6 / 10) 1 24 4 1 tau, mkSp (35 / 100) 0 92 1 1 tau,
    mkSp (3 / 10) 0 78 3 0 tau, mkSp (35 / 100) 1 75 2 1 tau ]

theorem mkSp_valid {om : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < om) (h1 : om < 1) {y : ℕ} (hy : y ≤ 200000)
    (calHits fpHits : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 18) {tau : ℝ} (t0 : 0 < tau) (t1 : tau ≤ 1) :
    (SpValid (mkSp om y calHits fpHits k tau)) := by
  have hc := coverFrac_bounds
  have ha0 : 0 < coverFrac * tau := mul_pos hc.1 t0
  have ha1 : coverFrac * tau ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [hc.2]
  have k20 : 0 < 20 := by norm_num
  have kk : 0 < 16 := by norm_num
  have hM : 1 ≤ (100000 : ℕ) := by norm_num
  have hy' : y ≤ 2 * 100000 := by omega
  exact ⟨hM, h0, h1,
    calGrid_pos 20 _ _ k20, scaledGrid_pos (calGrid_pos 20 _ _ k20) ha0 ha1,
    calGrid_pos 20 _ _ k20, flatGrid_pos 20 k20,
    calGrid_ok 20 _ _ k20, scaledGrid_ok (calGrid_ok 20 _ _ k20) ha0.le ha1,
    calGrid_ok 20 _ _ k20, flatGrid_ok 20 k20,
    hy', hk⟩

theorem lake_valid {tau : ℝ} (t0 : 0 < tau) (t1 : tau ≤ 1) : ∀ s ∈ lakeSpecies tau, (SpValid s) := by
  intro s hs
  simp only [lakeSpecies, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    exact mkSp_valid (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _ _ (by norm_num) t0 t1

/-- **Conclusion for the lake.**  For every field/reference detectability transfer factor
`tau ∈ (0,1]`: each panel species' posterior count law is a probability law on `{0..100000}` with
presence probability `1 - P(N=0 | data)` given by the explicit formula, and the posterior law of
the total panel-species count (independent species) is a probability law whose mean and variance
are the sums of the eight species posterior means and variances. -/
theorem lake_answer : ∀ tau : ℝ, 0 < tau → tau ≤ 1 →
    (∀ s ∈ lakeSpecies tau, IsLaw s.M (spPost s) ∧
      (spPresence s) = 1 - (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s)) ∧
    IsLaw (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).1 (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).2 ∧
    mean (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).1 (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).2
      = ((lakeSpecies tau).map (fun s => mean s.M (spPost s))).sum ∧
    var (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).1 (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).2
      = ((lakeSpecies tau).map (fun s => var s.M (spPost s))).sum :=
  fun _ t0 t1 => answer_theorem _ (lake_valid t0 t1)

import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Sum
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

open Finset

/-! # Lake inventory (SYNTHETIC survey VCS-LK-001) — review packet

SUPPLIED INFORMATION (data): per species camera labels y (all 18 videos), reference-video
calibration (hits/160, false labels/200), eDNA positive grabs k of 18 (any of 3 PCR libs),
blanks (1 positive of 16 field-blank taxon x grab cells), footprint 1260 m2 per pass of 57782.56 m2
mapped area, 2 passes.  See `mkSp` / `lakeSpecies`.

MODELLING CHOICES (not inferred; for review): (1) N=0 iff absent; prior P(N>0)=omega (table in
`lakeSpecies`, judgement, NOT from these data); N|present ~ 1/n on 1..100000 (scale-invariant,
capped). (2) camera labels = false labels (Binomial(36,phi)) + true encounters (Binomial(2N,q)),
phi, d from calibration by grid Bayes with flat prior; q = coverFrac*tau*d, tau = unidentified
field/reference transfer factor, reported as a scenario. (3) eDNA: grab positives patterned
Bernoulli with rate theta~flat if present, contamination f~grid posterior from blanks if absent.
(4) species independent given tau; non-panel fish excluded; sonar unused; mapped areas exact.
PROVED: normalisation/likelihood laws, presence formula, posterior laws, conv law of total, additive
mean/variance (`lake_answer`).  Numbers are NOT proved in Lean (see report.txt). -/

/-- Binomial pmf: number of successes in `m` independent trials of success probability `p`. -/
def binomPmf (m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ := (m.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (m - k)

theorem binomPmf_nonneg (m : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ binomPmf m p k := by
  unfold binomPmf
  have : 0 ≤ 1 - p := by linarith
  positivity

theorem binomPmf_sum (m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ∑ k ∈ range (m + 1), binomPmf m p k = 1 := by
  have h := add_pow p (1 - p) m
  have h2 : (p + (1 - p)) ^ m = 1 := by simp
  rw [h2] at h
  rw [h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  unfold binomPmf; ring

/-- `L` is a probability law on `{0,…,M}` (values beyond `M` are never used). -/
structure IsLaw (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ w n
  sum_one : ∑ n ∈ range (M + 1), w n = 1

/-- Expectation of `g` under `w` on `{0,…,M}`. -/
def E (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range (M + 1), w n * g n
def mean (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := E M w (fun n => (n : ℝ))
def var (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := E M w (fun n => ((n : ℝ) - mean M w) ^ 2)

/-- Law of `X + Y` for independent `X ~ a` on `{0..M1}` and `Y ~ b` on `{0..M2}`. -/
def conv (M1 M2 : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ := fun t =>
  ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), if i + j = t then a i * b j else 0

theorem conv_E (M1 M2 : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    E (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) g =
      ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * g (i + j) := by
  unfold E conv
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => ?_)
  have hm : i + j ∈ range (M1 + M2 + 1) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi hj ⊢; omega
  simp [ite_mul, hm]

theorem conv_isLaw {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (hb : IsLaw M2 b) :
    IsLaw (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) := by
  constructor
  · intro t
    unfold conv
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => ?_))
    split_ifs
    · exact mul_nonneg (ha.nonneg i) (hb.nonneg j)
    · exact le_refl _
  · have h := conv_E M1 M2 a b (fun _ => 1)
    unfold E at h
    simp only [mul_one] at h
    rw [h]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [hb.sum_one]
    simp [ha.sum_one]

/-- Summing out the second factor of a product law. -/
theorem sum_prod_left {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hb : IsLaw M2 b) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * F i
      = ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * F i := by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  have : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * F i = (a i * F i) * ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_); ring
  rw [this, hb.sum_one, mul_one]

theorem sum_prod_right {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * F j
      = ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * F j := by
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have : ∀ j, ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * b j * F j = (b j * F j) * ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i := by
    intro j; rw [Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_); ring
  simp only [this, ha.sum_one, mul_one]

theorem mean_conv {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (hb : IsLaw M2 b) :
    mean (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) = mean M1 a + mean M2 b := by
  unfold mean
  rw [conv_E]
  have h : ∀ i j : ℕ, a i * b j * ((((i + j : ℕ)) : ℝ)) =
      a i * b j * (i : ℝ) + a i * b j * (j : ℝ) := by intro i j; push_cast; ring
  simp only [h, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [sum_prod_left hb (fun i => (i : ℝ)), sum_prod_right ha (fun j => (j : ℝ))]
  rfl

theorem var_conv {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (hb : IsLaw M2 b) :
    var (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) = var M1 a + var M2 b := by
  unfold var
  rw [mean_conv ha hb, conv_E]
  set ma := mean M1 a
  set mb := mean M2 b
  have hca : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma) = 0 := by
    have : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma) = mean M1 a - ma * 1 := by
      simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [← ha.sum_one]; simp [mean, E, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
    rw [this]; simp [ma]
  have hcb : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb) = 0 := by
    have : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb) = mean M2 b - mb * 1 := by
      simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [← hb.sum_one]; simp [mean, E, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
    rw [this]; simp [mb]
  have h : ∀ i j : ℕ, a i * b j * ((((i + j : ℕ)) : ℝ) - (ma + mb)) ^ 2 =
      a i * b j * ((i : ℝ) - ma) ^ 2 + a i * b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb) ^ 2
        + 2 * ((a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) * (b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb))) := by
    intro i j; push_cast; ring
  simp only [h, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [sum_prod_left hb (fun i => ((i : ℝ) - ma) ^ 2), sum_prod_right ha (fun j => ((j : ℝ) - mb) ^ 2)]
  have hx : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1),
      2 * ((a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) * (b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb))) = 0 := by
    have : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1),
        2 * ((a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) * (b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb)))
        = 2 * ((∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) *
            (∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb))) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [this, hca]; simp
  rw [hx]
  simp [var, E, ma, mb]

/-! ### Parameter grids (finite discretisation of nuisance parameters) -/

/-- Discrete prior/posterior over a probability-valued nuisance parameter: weights `w i`, values `x i`, `i < K`. -/
structure Grid where
  K : ℕ
  w : ℕ → ℝ
  x : ℕ → ℝ

/-- Expectation of `f(parameter)` over the grid. -/
def gridAvg (g : Grid) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ range g.K, g.w i * f (g.x i)

/-- Probability weights, parameters in the closed unit interval. -/
structure GridOk (g : Grid) : Prop where
  w_nonneg : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ g.w i
  w_sum : ∑ i ∈ range g.K, g.w i = 1
  x_mem : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ g.x i ∧ g.x i ≤ 1

/-- Strictly positive weights and parameters strictly inside (0,1); at least one grid point. -/
structure GridPos (g : Grid) : Prop where
  K_pos : 0 < g.K
  w_pos : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 < g.w i
  x_in : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 < g.x i ∧ g.x i < 1

theorem gridAvg_nonneg (g : Grid) (hw : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ g.w i) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ f (g.x i)) : 0 ≤ (gridAvg g) f :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => mul_nonneg (hw i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) (hf i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))

theorem gridAvg_pos (g : Grid) (hp : (GridPos g)) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 < f (g.x i)) : 0 < (gridAvg g) f :=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun i hi => mul_pos (hp.w_pos i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) (hf i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))
    ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr hp.K_pos⟩

/-- A mixture of laws indexed by a grid is a law. -/
theorem mix_isLaw {g : Grid} (hg : (GridOk g)) {M : ℕ} {L : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ i, i < g.K → IsLaw M (L (g.x i))) : IsLaw M (fun k => (gridAvg g) (fun p => L p k)) := by
  constructor
  · intro k
    exact (gridAvg_nonneg g) hg.w_nonneg (fun i hi => (hL i hi).nonneg k)
  · unfold gridAvg
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have : ∀ i ∈ range g.K, ∑ k ∈ range (M + 1), g.w i * L (g.x i) k = g.w i := by
      intro i hi
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, (hL i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).sum_one, mul_one]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this]
    exact hg.w_sum

theorem binomPmf_isLaw (m : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) : IsLaw m (binomPmf m p) :=
  ⟨binomPmf_nonneg m h0 h1, binomPmf_sum m p⟩

theorem binomPmf_pos (m : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < p) (h1 : p < 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) :
    0 < binomPmf m p k := by
  unfold binomPmf
  have : 0 < 1 - p := by linarith
  have := Nat.choose_pos hk
  positivity

/-- Calibration step: grid posterior of a success probability after `hits` successes in `trials`
trials, from a flat prior on the midpoints `(i+1/2)/K` (Bayes' rule on a grid). -/
noncomputable def calGrid (K hits trials : ℕ) : Grid where
  K := K
  w := fun i => (((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits * (1 - ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) /
    ∑ j ∈ range K, (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits * (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits)
  x := fun i => ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K

/-- Flat grid (no calibration information). -/
noncomputable def flatGrid (K : ℕ) : Grid where
  K := K
  w := fun _ => 1 / K
  x := fun i => ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K

theorem grid_x_in (K : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < K) :
    0 < ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K ∧ ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K < 1 := by
  have hK : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hi)
  have hi' : (i : ℝ) + 1 ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hi
  constructor
  · positivity
  · rw [div_lt_one hK]; linarith

theorem grid_x_in' (K : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K ∧
    (i < K → ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K ≤ 1) := by
  refine ⟨by positivity, fun hi => (grid_x_in K hi).2.le⟩

theorem calGrid_pos (K hits trials : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridPos (calGrid K hits trials)) := by
  have hterm : ∀ j, j < K → 0 < (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits *
      (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) := by
    intro j hj
    have h := grid_x_in K hj
    have : 0 < 1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K := by linarith [h.2]
    have := h.1
    positivity
  have hS : 0 < ∑ j ∈ range K, (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits *
      (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun j hj => hterm j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr hK⟩
  refine ⟨hK, fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi => grid_x_in K hi⟩
  exact div_pos (hterm i hi) hS

theorem flatGrid_pos (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridPos (flatGrid K)) := by
  refine ⟨hK, fun i _ => ?_, fun i hi => grid_x_in K hi⟩
  have : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  show 0 < 1 / (K : ℝ)
  positivity

theorem calGrid_sum (K hits trials : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (calGrid K hits trials).K, (calGrid K hits trials).w i = 1 := by
  have hp := calGrid_pos K hits trials hK
  show ∑ i ∈ range K, _ = 1
  have hS : 0 < ∑ j ∈ range K, (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits *
      (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) := by
    refine Finset.sum_pos (fun j hj => ?_) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr hK⟩
    have h := grid_x_in K (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    have : 0 < 1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K := by linarith [h.2]
    have := h.1
    positivity
  show ∑ i ∈ range K, (_ / _) = 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self hS.ne'

theorem calGrid_ok (K hits trials : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridOk (calGrid K hits trials)) := by
  have hp := calGrid_pos K hits trials hK
  exact ⟨fun i hi => (hp.w_pos i hi).le, calGrid_sum K hits trials hK,
    fun i hi => ⟨(hp.x_in i hi).1.le, (hp.x_in i hi).2.le⟩⟩

theorem flatGrid_ok (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridOk (flatGrid K)) := by
  have hp := flatGrid_pos K hK
  refine ⟨fun i hi => (hp.w_pos i hi).le, ?_, fun i hi => ⟨(hp.x_in i hi).1.le, (hp.x_in i hi).2.le⟩⟩
  show ∑ i ∈ range K, (1 / (K : ℝ)) = 1
  have : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hK.ne'
  simp [this]

/-! ### Species model -/

/-- Harmonic normaliser of the scale-invariant (1/n) prior on `{1,…,M}`. -/
noncomputable def harm (M : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ range M, 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)

/-- Everything specific to one species: prior, camera model, eDNA model, observed data. -/
structure Sp where
  M : ℕ        -- carrying-capacity cap on the number of individuals
  omega : ℝ    -- prior probability that the species is present (N > 0)
  y : ℕ        -- observed camera labels of this species (all 18 videos, both size bins)
  m : ℕ        -- number of fish-free-video-like opportunities for a false label (18 videos x 2 bins)
  c : ℕ        -- number of independent passes (each fish can be encountered once per pass)
  gF : Grid    -- per-opportunity false-label probability
  gQ : Grid    -- per-fish, per-pass probability of a correctly labelled encounter
  k : ℕ        -- water grabs with species-positive eDNA
  nG : ℕ       -- total water grabs
  gC : Grid    -- per-grab false-positive (contamination) probability when absent
  gT : Grid    -- per-grab detection probability when present

/-- Prior law of `N`: `P(N=0)=1-ω`; given presence `P(N=n) ∝ 1/n` on `1..M`. -/
noncomputable def spPrior (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n = 0 then 1 - s.omega else s.omega * (1 / (n : ℝ)) / harm s.M

/-- Law of the number of false labels. -/
def spPF (s : Sp) : ℕ → ℝ := fun f => (gridAvg s.gF) (fun p => binomPmf s.m p f)
/-- Law of the number of true encounters given `N = n`. -/
def spPT (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => (gridAvg s.gQ) (fun q => binomPmf (s.c * n) q t)
/-- Likelihood of observing `y` camera labels given `N = n`: false labels + true encounters. -/
def spCamLik (s : Sp) (n y : ℕ) : ℝ := conv s.m (s.c * n) (spPF s) ((spPT s) n) y

/-- Probability of the observed eDNA grab pattern given absent / present. -/
def pattern (k nG : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ := p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (nG - k)
noncomputable def spEdnaLik (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n = 0 then (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) else (gridAvg s.gT) (pattern s.k s.nG)

/-- Unnormalised posterior and evidence. -/
noncomputable def spUnnorm (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (spPrior s) n * (spCamLik s) n s.y * (spEdnaLik s) n
noncomputable def spZ (s : Sp) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range (s.M + 1), (spUnnorm s) n
/-- Posterior law of the number of individuals (Bayes' rule). -/
noncomputable def spPost (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (spUnnorm s) n / (spZ s)

/-- Presence means at least one living individual. -/
noncomputable def spPresence (s : Sp) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range (s.M + 1), if 0 < n then (spPost s) n else 0

structure SpValid (s : Sp) : Prop where
  M_pos : 1 ≤ s.M
  omega_pos : 0 < s.omega
  omega_lt : s.omega < 1
  gF : (GridPos s.gF)
  gQ : (GridPos s.gQ)
  gC : (GridPos s.gC)
  gT : (GridPos s.gT)
  gFo : (GridOk s.gF)
  gQo : (GridOk s.gQ)
  gCo : (GridOk s.gC)
  gTo : (GridOk s.gT)
  y_le : s.y ≤ s.c * s.M
  nG_ge : s.k ≤ s.nG

theorem harm_pos {M : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ M) : 0 < harm M := by
  unfold harm
  refine Finset.sum_pos (fun k _ => by positivity) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr h⟩

theorem prior_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : IsLaw s.M (spPrior s) := by
  have hH := harm_pos h.M_pos
  constructor
  · intro n
    unfold spPrior
    split_ifs
    · linarith [h.omega_lt]
    · have := h.omega_pos; positivity
  · rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [spPrior]
    simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, if_true]
    have : ∑ i ∈ range s.M, s.omega * (1 / (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) / harm s.M = s.omega := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have : ∑ i ∈ range s.M, (1 / (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) = harm s.M := by
        unfold harm; push_cast; rfl
      rw [this]; field_simp
    rw [this]; ring

theorem pF_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : IsLaw s.m (spPF s) :=
  mix_isLaw h.gFo (fun i hi => binomPmf_isLaw s.m (h.gFo.x_mem i hi).1 (h.gFo.x_mem i hi).2)

theorem pT_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : IsLaw (s.c * n) ((spPT s) n) :=
  mix_isLaw h.gQo (fun i hi => binomPmf_isLaw (s.c * n) (h.gQo.x_mem i hi).1 (h.gQo.x_mem i hi).2)

/-- The camera likelihood is a genuine probability law for the data `y` given `N = n`. -/
theorem camLik_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) :
    IsLaw (s.m + s.c * n) (fun y => (spCamLik s) n y) :=
  conv_isLaw (pF_isLaw h) (pT_isLaw h n)

theorem ednaLik_nonneg {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (spEdnaLik s) n := by
  unfold spEdnaLik
  have key : ∀ g : Grid, (GridOk g) → 0 ≤ (gridAvg g) (pattern s.k s.nG) := by
    intro g hg
    refine (gridAvg_nonneg g) hg.w_nonneg (fun i hi => ?_)
    have := hg.x_mem i hi
    unfold pattern
    have : 0 ≤ 1 - g.x i := by linarith [this.2]
    have := (hg.x_mem i hi).1
    positivity
  split_ifs
  · exact key _ h.gCo
  · exact key _ h.gTo

theorem ednaLik_pos {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : 0 < (spEdnaLik s) n := by
  unfold spEdnaLik
  have key : ∀ g : Grid, (GridPos g) → 0 < (gridAvg g) (pattern s.k s.nG) := by
    intro g hg
    refine (gridAvg_pos g) hg (fun i hi => ?_)
    have := hg.x_in i hi
    unfold pattern
    have : 0 < 1 - g.x i := by linarith [this.2]
    have := (hg.x_in i hi).1
    positivity
  split_ifs
  · exact key _ h.gC
  · exact key _ h.gT

theorem unnorm_nonneg {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (spUnnorm s) n := by
  unfold spUnnorm
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ((prior_isLaw h).nonneg n) ((camLik_isLaw h n).nonneg _))
    (ednaLik_nonneg h n)

theorem conv_pos {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n)
    (ha0 : 0 < a 0) {y : ℕ} (hy : y ≤ M2) (hby : 0 < b y) : 0 < conv M1 M2 a b y := by
  unfold conv
  have h0 : 0 ∈ range (M1 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos _)
  have hyr : y ∈ range (M2 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hy)
  have inner_nn : ∀ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1),
      (if i + j = y then a i * b j else 0) := fun i _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs; exact mul_nonneg (ha i) (hb j); exact le_refl _)
  have h1 := Finset.single_le_sum inner_nn h0
  have h2 := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => if 0 + j = y then a 0 * b j else 0)
    (fun j _ => by split_ifs; exact mul_nonneg (ha 0) (hb j); exact le_refl _) hyr
  simp only [zero_add, if_true] at h2
  have : 0 < a 0 * b y := mul_pos ha0 hby
  simp only [zero_add] at h1
  linarith

theorem camLik_pos {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : 0 < (spCamLik s) s.M s.y := by
  unfold spCamLik
  have hF0 : 0 < (spPF s) 0 := by
    refine (gridAvg_pos s.gF) h.gF (fun i hi => binomPmf_pos s.m (h.gF.x_in i hi).1 (h.gF.x_in i hi).2 (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hT : 0 < (spPT s) s.M s.y :=
    (gridAvg_pos s.gQ) h.gQ (fun i hi => binomPmf_pos _ (h.gQ.x_in i hi).1 (h.gQ.x_in i hi).2 h.y_le)
  exact conv_pos (pF_isLaw h).nonneg (pT_isLaw h s.M).nonneg hF0 h.y_le hT

/-- The data are possible under the model: the evidence is strictly positive. -/
theorem Z_pos {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : 0 < (spZ s) := by
  unfold spZ
  have hH := harm_pos h.M_pos
  refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun n _ => unnorm_nonneg h n) ⟨s.M, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self _), ?_⟩
  unfold spUnnorm spPrior
  have hM : s.M ≠ 0 := by have := h.M_pos; omega
  simp only [hM, if_false]
  have := h.omega_pos
  have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < s.M := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hM
  have := camLik_pos h
  have := ednaLik_pos h s.M
  positivity

/-- The posterior is a probability law on `{0,…,M}`. -/
theorem post_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : IsLaw s.M (spPost s) := by
  have hZ := Z_pos h
  constructor
  · intro n; exact div_nonneg (unnorm_nonneg h n) hZ.le
  · unfold spPost
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hZ.ne'

/-- Posterior probability of presence (`N > 0`) is `1 - P(N = 0 | data)`, with the explicit form of
`P(N=0 | data)`. -/
theorem presence_formula {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) :
    (spPresence s) = 1 - (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s) := by
  have hl := (post_isLaw h).sum_one
  unfold spPresence
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at hl ⊢
  simp only [Nat.succ_pos, if_true, lt_self_iff_false, if_false, add_zero] at hl ⊢
  have h0 : (spPost s) 0 = (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s) := by
    simp [spPost, spUnnorm, spPrior, spEdnaLik]
  linarith

/-- With no camera false labels possible, one labelled encounter excludes absence. -/
theorem camera_excludes_absence {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (hy : 0 < s.y)
    (hnofp : ∀ i, i < s.gF.K → s.gF.x i = 0) : (spPresence s) = 1 := by
  rw [presence_formula h]
  have hz : (spCamLik s) 0 s.y = 0 := by
    unfold spCamLik conv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hjm => ?_))
    have hj : j = 0 := by simp at hjm; omega
    split_ifs with hij
    · have hi : i ≠ 0 := by omega
      have : (spPF s) i = 0 := by
        unfold spPF gridAvg
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun l hl => ?_)
        rw [hnofp l (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)]
        simp [binomPmf, hi]
      rw [this, zero_mul]
    · rfl
  rw [hz]; simp

/-- Independence: with a product prior and a product likelihood, the joint posterior of two
species is the product of the marginal posteriors. -/
theorem joint_posterior_factorizes {M1 M2 : ℕ} {pa pb la lb : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hZa : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), pa i * la i ≠ 0) (hZb : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), pb j * lb j ≠ 0)
    (i j : ℕ) :
    (pa i * pb j * (la i * lb j)) /
        ∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pa i' * pb j' * (la i' * lb j') =
      ((pa i * la i) / ∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), pa i' * la i') *
        ((pb j * lb j) / ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pb j' * lb j') := by
  have : ∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pa i' * pb j' * (la i' * lb j') =
      (∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), pa i' * la i') * ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pb j' * lb j' := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j' _ => ?_))
    ring
  rw [this]
  field_simp

/-! ### Total population -/

/-- Law (support bound, pmf) of the total of a list of independent species counts. -/
noncomputable def totalLaw : List Sp → ℕ × (ℕ → ℝ)
  | [] => (0, fun n => if n = 0 then 1 else 0)
  | s :: ss => (s.M + (totalLaw ss).1, conv s.M (totalLaw ss).1 (spPost s) (totalLaw ss).2)

theorem totalLaw_spec : ∀ l : List Sp, (∀ s ∈ l, (SpValid s)) →
    IsLaw (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 ∧
    mean (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => mean s.M (spPost s))).sum ∧
    var (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => var s.M (spPost s))).sum
  | [], _ => by
    refine ⟨⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [totalLaw]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
    · simp [totalLaw]
    · simp [totalLaw, mean, E]
    · simp [totalLaw, var, E, mean]
  | s :: ss, hv => by
    have hs : (SpValid s) := hv s (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := totalLaw_spec ss (fun t ht => hv t (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ht))
    have hl := post_isLaw hs
    refine ⟨conv_isLaw hl h1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [totalLaw, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [mean_conv hl h1, h2]
    · simp only [totalLaw, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [var_conv hl h1, h3]

/-- **Answer.** For independent species counts whose posteriors are defined by the Bayesian model
above: each species posterior is a probability law, its presence probability is given by the
explicit formula, a labelled camera encounter excludes absence when no false labels are possible,
and the total population posterior is the convolution of the species laws, a probability law
whose mean and variance are the sums of the species means and variances. -/
theorem answer_theorem : ∀ l : List Sp, (∀ s ∈ l, (SpValid s)) →
    (∀ s ∈ l, IsLaw s.M (spPost s) ∧
      (spPresence s) = 1 - (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s)) ∧
    IsLaw (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 ∧
    mean (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => mean s.M (spPost s))).sum ∧
    var (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => var s.M (spPost s))).sum := by
  intro l hv
  exact ⟨fun s hs => ⟨post_isLaw (hv s hs), presence_formula (hv s hs)⟩, totalLaw_spec l hv⟩

/-! ### The lake: data and explicit modelling choices -/

/-- Rescale the parameters of a grid by a factor `a` (used for transfer/coverage). -/
def scaledGrid (g : Grid) (a : ℝ) : Grid where
  K := g.K
  w := g.w
  x := fun i => a * g.x i

theorem scaledGrid_pos {g : Grid} (hg : (GridPos g)) {a : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < a) (h1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (GridPos (scaledGrid g a)) := by
  refine ⟨hg.K_pos, hg.w_pos, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have := hg.x_in i hi
  show 0 < a * g.x i ∧ a * g.x i < 1
  constructor
  · exact mul_pos h0 this.1
  · nlinarith [this.1, this.2]

theorem scaledGrid_ok {g : Grid} (hg : (GridOk g)) {a : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ a) (h1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (GridOk (scaledGrid g a)) := by
  refine ⟨hg.w_nonneg, hg.w_sum, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have := hg.x_mem i hi
  show 0 ≤ a * g.x i ∧ a * g.x i ≤ 1
  constructor
  · exact mul_nonneg h0 this.1
  · nlinarith [this.1, this.2]

/-- Fraction of the mapped lake area (57 782.56 m²) covered by the 9 camera footprints (1260 m²)
of one pass. -/
noncomputable def coverFrac : ℝ := 1260 / 57782.56

theorem coverFrac_bounds : 0 < coverFrac ∧ coverFrac < 1 := by
  unfold coverFrac; constructor <;> norm_num

/-- One panel species.  `om` prior presence probability; `y` camera labels; `calHits` correct
labels out of 160 reference encounters; `fpHits` false labels in 200 fish-free reference videos;
`k` eDNA-positive grabs of 18; `tau` field/reference detectability transfer factor. -/
noncomputable def mkSp (om : ℝ) (y calHits fpHits k : ℕ) (tau : ℝ) : Sp where
  M := 100000
  omega := om
  y := y
  m := 36
  c := 2
  gF := calGrid 20 fpHits 200
  gQ := scaledGrid (calGrid 20 calHits 160) (coverFrac * tau)
  k := k
  nG := 18
  gC := calGrid 20 1 16
  gT := flatGrid 20

/-- The eight panel species, in order: perch, roach, ruffe, pike, burbot, bleak, vendace, bream. -/
noncomputable def lakeSpecies (tau : ℝ) : List Sp :=
  [ mkSp (97 / 100) 39 97 2 17 tau, mkSp (9 / 10) 26 82 2 17 tau,
    mkSp (8 / 10) 1 29 1 14 tau, mkSp (9 / 10) 1 67 6 9 tau,
    mkSp (6 / 10) 1 24 4 1 tau, mkSp (35 / 100) 0 92 1 1 tau,
    mkSp (3 / 10) 0 78 3 0 tau, mkSp (35 / 100) 1 75 2 1 tau ]

theorem mkSp_valid {om : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < om) (h1 : om < 1) {y : ℕ} (hy : y ≤ 200000)
    (calHits fpHits : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 18) {tau : ℝ} (t0 : 0 < tau) (t1 : tau ≤ 1) :
    (SpValid (mkSp om y calHits fpHits k tau)) := by
  have hc := coverFrac_bounds
  have ha0 : 0 < coverFrac * tau := mul_pos hc.1 t0
  have ha1 : coverFrac * tau ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [hc.2]
  have k20 : 0 < 20 := by norm_num
  have kk : 0 < 16 := by norm_num
  have hM : 1 ≤ (100000 : ℕ) := by norm_num
  have hy' : y ≤ 2 * 100000 := by omega
  exact ⟨hM, h0, h1,
    calGrid_pos 20 _ _ k20, scaledGrid_pos (calGrid_pos 20 _ _ k20) ha0 ha1,
    calGrid_pos 20 _ _ k20, flatGrid_pos 20 k20,
    calGrid_ok 20 _ _ k20, scaledGrid_ok (calGrid_ok 20 _ _ k20) ha0.le ha1,
    calGrid_ok 20 _ _ k20, flatGrid_ok 20 k20,
    hy', hk⟩

theorem lake_valid {tau : ℝ} (t0 : 0 < tau) (t1 : tau ≤ 1) : ∀ s ∈ lakeSpecies tau, (SpValid s) := by
  intro s hs
  simp only [lakeSpecies, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    exact mkSp_valid (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _ _ (by norm_num) t0 t1

/-- **Conclusion for the lake.**  For every field/reference detectability transfer factor
`tau ∈ (0,1]`: each panel species' posterior count law is a probability law on `{0..100000}` with
presence probability `1 - P(N=0 | data)` given by the explicit formula, and the posterior law of
the total panel-species count (independent species) is a probability law whose mean and variance
are the sums of the eight species posterior means and variances. -/
theorem lake_answer : ∀ tau : ℝ, 0 < tau → tau ≤ 1 →
    (∀ s ∈ lakeSpecies tau, IsLaw s.M (spPost s) ∧
      (spPresence s) = 1 - (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s)) ∧
    IsLaw (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).1 (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).2 ∧
    mean (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).1 (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).2
      = ((lakeSpecies tau).map (fun s => mean s.M (spPost s))).sum ∧
    var (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).1 (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).2
      = ((lakeSpecies tau).map (fun s => var s.M (spPost s))).sum :=
  fun _ t0 t1 => answer_theorem _ (lake_valid t0 t1)

plug-in detection and hard-coded moment formulas were removed. The Lean file now defines the probability model
(binomial pmfs, grid mixtures, convolution, Bayes' rule) and PROVES: likelihood is a normalised pmf; the prior is a law;
the posterior is a law; presence = 1-P(N=0|data) with explicit formula; a camera label excludes absence if false labels are
impossible; the total is the convolution of independent species laws and its mean/variance are sums. Numerical values below
come from a separate Python calculation of the same model (SYNTHETIC CALCULATION; analysis/model.py, run3.py,
results3.txt) and are NOT proved in Lean.
The negative-binomial/Gamma-Poisson family was dropped because the Lean build available here has no measure/integral library,
so the Gamma mixture cannot be formalised; a finite-support discrete prior is used instead and is exposed as a choice.

SPECIES PRESENT (posterior P(N>0), tau-insensitive): perch ~1.00, roach ~1.00, ruffe ~1.00 (eDNA 14/18 grabs, far above the
~6% contamination rate), pike ~0.89-0.99 (eDNA 9/18; camera labels 1 but false-label rate 3%/video), burbot 0.10-0.17
(one eDNA library + one camera label, same as the one blank contamination event), bleak 0.04-0.08, vendace 0.03-0.08,
common bream 0.05-0.10. Prior sensitivity: omega informed vs flat 0.5 changes these by the ranges given.
Non-panel species cannot be assessed (reference panel is not a presence list).

ABUNDANCE (posterior mean of N; scenario on transfer factor tau = field/reference detectability, NOT identifiable from data):
tau=1: perch 1450, roach 1130, ruffe 45, pike 22, others <10; total panel 2650 (sd 370; 90% 2090-3290)
tau=.75: total 3530 (sd 490; 2780-4380); tau=.5: total 5290 (sd 735; 4160-6560); tau=.25: total 10560 (sd 1470; 8300-13100).
The scenario spread (factor ~4) dominates statistical uncertainty. Flat omega changes total by <0.2%.

TOTAL: law of sum of independent species posteriors = convolution (proved structure; computed numerically by FFT).
Quantity: living fish of the eight panel species in the mapped strata (littoral/open/deep) for the stated late-August window,
counted in "camera-detectable" terms; non-panel fish, unmapped habitat, sonar data (no species ID, 38-58% false-positive
rate, not used), size-bin structure (pooled with equal weight) and repeat-encounter dependence (treated as independent
passes) are NOT modelled. So this is a conditional LOWER-type estimate of the total fish population.

APPROXIMATIONS TO REVIEW: omega table (literature judgement for boreal Finnish lakes; not verified, no request made),
1/n prior with cap 1e5, flat transfer tau scenarios, pooling of contamination across taxa (1/16 blank cells) and transfer from
blanks to lake water, grid discretisation (20 points), area treated exact (12 mapping replicates suggest ~3% sd), dependence
between species through shared tau / contamination / areas ignored beyond conditioning on tau, camera size bins pooled.
