import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Sum
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

open Finset

/-! # Lake inventory (SYNTHETIC survey VCS-LK-001) — review packet

SUPPLIED INFORMATION (data): per species camera labels y (all 18 videos), reference-video
calibration (hits/160, false labels/200), eDNA positive grabs k of 18 (any of 3 PCR libs),
blanks (1 positive of 16 field-blank taxon x grab cells), footprint 1260 m2 per pass of 57782.56 m2
mapped area, 2 passes.  See `mkSp` / `lakeSpecies`.

MODELLING CHOICES (not inferred; for review): (1) N=0 iff absent; prior P(N>0)=omega (table in
`lakeSpecies`, judgement, NOT from these data); N|present ~ 1/n on 1..100000 (scale-invariant,
capped). (2) camera labels = false labels (Binomial(36,phi)) + true encounters (Binomial(2N,q)),
phi, d from calibration by grid Bayes with flat prior; q = coverFrac*tau*d, tau = unidentified
field/reference transfer factor, reported as a scenario. (3) eDNA: grab positives patterned
Bernoulli with rate theta~flat if present, contamination f~grid posterior from blanks if absent.
(4) species independent given tau; non-panel fish excluded; sonar unused; mapped areas exact.
PROVED: normalisation/likelihood laws, presence formula, posterior laws, conv law of total, additive
mean/variance (`lake_answer`).  Numbers are NOT proved in Lean (see report.txt). -/

/-- Binomial pmf: number of successes in `m` independent trials of success probability `p`. -/
def binomPmf (m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ := (m.choose k : ℝ) * p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (m - k)

theorem binomPmf_nonneg (m : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ binomPmf m p k := by
  unfold binomPmf
  have : 0 ≤ 1 - p := by linarith
  positivity

theorem binomPmf_sum (m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ∑ k ∈ range (m + 1), binomPmf m p k = 1 := by
  have h := add_pow p (1 - p) m
  have h2 : (p + (1 - p)) ^ m = 1 := by simp
  rw [h2] at h
  rw [h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  unfold binomPmf; ring

/-- `L` is a probability law on `{0,…,M}` (values beyond `M` are never used). -/
structure IsLaw (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ w n
  sum_one : ∑ n ∈ range (M + 1), w n = 1

/-- Expectation of `g` under `w` on `{0,…,M}`. -/
def E (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range (M + 1), w n * g n
def mean (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := E M w (fun n => (n : ℝ))
def var (M : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ := E M w (fun n => ((n : ℝ) - mean M w) ^ 2)

/-- Law of `X + Y` for independent `X ~ a` on `{0..M1}` and `Y ~ b` on `{0..M2}`. -/
def conv (M1 M2 : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ := fun t =>
  ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), if i + j = t then a i * b j else 0

theorem conv_E (M1 M2 : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) :
    E (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) g =
      ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * g (i + j) := by
  unfold E conv
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => ?_)
  have hm : i + j ∈ range (M1 + M2 + 1) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi hj ⊢; omega
  simp [ite_mul, hm]

theorem conv_isLaw {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (hb : IsLaw M2 b) :
    IsLaw (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) := by
  constructor
  · intro t
    unfold conv
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => ?_))
    split_ifs
    · exact mul_nonneg (ha.nonneg i) (hb.nonneg j)
    · exact le_refl _
  · have h := conv_E M1 M2 a b (fun _ => 1)
    unfold E at h
    simp only [mul_one] at h
    rw [h]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [hb.sum_one]
    simp [ha.sum_one]

/-- Summing out the second factor of a product law. -/
theorem sum_prod_left {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (hb : IsLaw M2 b) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * F i
      = ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * F i := by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  have : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * F i = (a i * F i) * ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_); ring
  rw [this, hb.sum_one, mul_one]

theorem sum_prod_right {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), a i * b j * F j
      = ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * F j := by
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have : ∀ j, ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * b j * F j = (b j * F j) * ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i := by
    intro j; rw [Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_); ring
  simp only [this, ha.sum_one, mul_one]

theorem mean_conv {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (hb : IsLaw M2 b) :
    mean (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) = mean M1 a + mean M2 b := by
  unfold mean
  rw [conv_E]
  have h : ∀ i j : ℕ, a i * b j * ((((i + j : ℕ)) : ℝ)) =
      a i * b j * (i : ℝ) + a i * b j * (j : ℝ) := by intro i j; push_cast; ring
  simp only [h, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [sum_prod_left hb (fun i => (i : ℝ)), sum_prod_right ha (fun j => (j : ℝ))]
  rfl

theorem var_conv {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : IsLaw M1 a) (hb : IsLaw M2 b) :
    var (M1 + M2) (conv M1 M2 a b) = var M1 a + var M2 b := by
  unfold var
  rw [mean_conv ha hb, conv_E]
  set ma := mean M1 a
  set mb := mean M2 b
  have hca : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma) = 0 := by
    have : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma) = mean M1 a - ma * 1 := by
      simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [← ha.sum_one]; simp [mean, E, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
    rw [this]; simp [ma]
  have hcb : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb) = 0 := by
    have : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb) = mean M2 b - mb * 1 := by
      simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [← hb.sum_one]; simp [mean, E, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
    rw [this]; simp [mb]
  have h : ∀ i j : ℕ, a i * b j * ((((i + j : ℕ)) : ℝ) - (ma + mb)) ^ 2 =
      a i * b j * ((i : ℝ) - ma) ^ 2 + a i * b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb) ^ 2
        + 2 * ((a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) * (b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb))) := by
    intro i j; push_cast; ring
  simp only [h, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [sum_prod_left hb (fun i => ((i : ℝ) - ma) ^ 2), sum_prod_right ha (fun j => ((j : ℝ) - mb) ^ 2)]
  have hx : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1),
      2 * ((a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) * (b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb))) = 0 := by
    have : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1),
        2 * ((a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) * (b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb)))
        = 2 * ((∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), a i * ((i : ℝ) - ma)) *
            (∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), b j * ((j : ℝ) - mb))) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [this, hca]; simp
  rw [hx]
  simp [var, E, ma, mb]

/-! ### Parameter grids (finite discretisation of nuisance parameters) -/

/-- Discrete prior/posterior over a probability-valued nuisance parameter: weights `w i`, values `x i`, `i < K`. -/
structure Grid where
  K : ℕ
  w : ℕ → ℝ
  x : ℕ → ℝ

/-- Expectation of `f(parameter)` over the grid. -/
def gridAvg (g : Grid) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ range g.K, g.w i * f (g.x i)

/-- Probability weights, parameters in the closed unit interval. -/
structure GridOk (g : Grid) : Prop where
  w_nonneg : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ g.w i
  w_sum : ∑ i ∈ range g.K, g.w i = 1
  x_mem : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ g.x i ∧ g.x i ≤ 1

/-- Strictly positive weights and parameters strictly inside (0,1); at least one grid point. -/
structure GridPos (g : Grid) : Prop where
  K_pos : 0 < g.K
  w_pos : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 < g.w i
  x_in : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 < g.x i ∧ g.x i < 1

theorem gridAvg_nonneg (g : Grid) (hw : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ g.w i) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 ≤ f (g.x i)) : 0 ≤ (gridAvg g) f :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => mul_nonneg (hw i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) (hf i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))

theorem gridAvg_pos (g : Grid) (hp : (GridPos g)) {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ i, i < g.K → 0 < f (g.x i)) : 0 < (gridAvg g) f :=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun i hi => mul_pos (hp.w_pos i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) (hf i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))
    ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr hp.K_pos⟩

/-- A mixture of laws indexed by a grid is a law. -/
theorem mix_isLaw {g : Grid} (hg : (GridOk g)) {M : ℕ} {L : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ i, i < g.K → IsLaw M (L (g.x i))) : IsLaw M (fun k => (gridAvg g) (fun p => L p k)) := by
  constructor
  · intro k
    exact (gridAvg_nonneg g) hg.w_nonneg (fun i hi => (hL i hi).nonneg k)
  · unfold gridAvg
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have : ∀ i ∈ range g.K, ∑ k ∈ range (M + 1), g.w i * L (g.x i) k = g.w i := by
      intro i hi
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, (hL i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).sum_one, mul_one]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this]
    exact hg.w_sum

theorem binomPmf_isLaw (m : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) : IsLaw m (binomPmf m p) :=
  ⟨binomPmf_nonneg m h0 h1, binomPmf_sum m p⟩
Bash input
{
  "command": "cd /work; sed -n 200,700p Model.lean; cat human-feedback.json; ls checks | tail -5; ls checks/$(ls checks|tail -1)"
}
Bash output
theorem binomPmf_pos (m : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < p) (h1 : p < 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) :
    0 < binomPmf m p k := by
  unfold binomPmf
  have : 0 < 1 - p := by linarith
  have := Nat.choose_pos hk
  positivity

/-- Calibration step: grid posterior of a success probability after `hits` successes in `trials`
trials, from a flat prior on the midpoints `(i+1/2)/K` (Bayes' rule on a grid). -/
noncomputable def calGrid (K hits trials : ℕ) : Grid where
  K := K
  w := fun i => (((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits * (1 - ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) /
    ∑ j ∈ range K, (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits * (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits)
  x := fun i => ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K

/-- Flat grid (no calibration information). -/
noncomputable def flatGrid (K : ℕ) : Grid where
  K := K
  w := fun _ => 1 / K
  x := fun i => ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K

theorem grid_x_in (K : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < K) :
    0 < ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K ∧ ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K < 1 := by
  have hK : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hi)
  have hi' : (i : ℝ) + 1 ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hi
  constructor
  · positivity
  · rw [div_lt_one hK]; linarith

theorem grid_x_in' (K : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K ∧
    (i < K → ((i : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K ≤ 1) := by
  refine ⟨by positivity, fun hi => (grid_x_in K hi).2.le⟩

theorem calGrid_pos (K hits trials : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridPos (calGrid K hits trials)) := by
  have hterm : ∀ j, j < K → 0 < (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits *
      (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) := by
    intro j hj
    have h := grid_x_in K hj
    have : 0 < 1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K := by linarith [h.2]
    have := h.1
    positivity
  have hS : 0 < ∑ j ∈ range K, (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits *
      (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun j hj => hterm j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr hK⟩
  refine ⟨hK, fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi => grid_x_in K hi⟩
  exact div_pos (hterm i hi) hS

theorem flatGrid_pos (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridPos (flatGrid K)) := by
  refine ⟨hK, fun i _ => ?_, fun i hi => grid_x_in K hi⟩
  have : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast hK
  show 0 < 1 / (K : ℝ)
  positivity

theorem calGrid_sum (K hits trials : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (calGrid K hits trials).K, (calGrid K hits trials).w i = 1 := by
  have hp := calGrid_pos K hits trials hK
  show ∑ i ∈ range K, _ = 1
  have hS : 0 < ∑ j ∈ range K, (((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ hits *
      (1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K) ^ (trials - hits) := by
    refine Finset.sum_pos (fun j hj => ?_) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr hK⟩
    have h := grid_x_in K (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    have : 0 < 1 - ((j : ℝ) + 1 / 2) / K := by linarith [h.2]
    have := h.1
    positivity
  show ∑ i ∈ range K, (_ / _) = 1
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self hS.ne'

theorem calGrid_ok (K hits trials : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridOk (calGrid K hits trials)) := by
  have hp := calGrid_pos K hits trials hK
  exact ⟨fun i hi => (hp.w_pos i hi).le, calGrid_sum K hits trials hK,
    fun i hi => ⟨(hp.x_in i hi).1.le, (hp.x_in i hi).2.le⟩⟩

theorem flatGrid_ok (K : ℕ) (hK : 0 < K) : (GridOk (flatGrid K)) := by
  have hp := flatGrid_pos K hK
  refine ⟨fun i hi => (hp.w_pos i hi).le, ?_, fun i hi => ⟨(hp.x_in i hi).1.le, (hp.x_in i hi).2.le⟩⟩
  show ∑ i ∈ range K, (1 / (K : ℝ)) = 1
  have : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hK.ne'
  simp [this]

/-! ### Species model -/

/-- Harmonic normaliser of the scale-invariant (1/n) prior on `{1,…,M}`. -/
noncomputable def harm (M : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ range M, 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)

/-- Everything specific to one species: prior, camera model, eDNA model, observed data. -/
structure Sp where
  M : ℕ        -- carrying-capacity cap on the number of individuals
  omega : ℝ    -- prior probability that the species is present (N > 0)
  y : ℕ        -- observed camera labels of this species (all 18 videos, both size bins)
  m : ℕ        -- number of fish-free-video-like opportunities for a false label (18 videos x 2 bins)
  c : ℕ        -- number of independent passes (each fish can be encountered once per pass)
  gF : Grid    -- per-opportunity false-label probability
  gQ : Grid    -- per-fish, per-pass probability of a correctly labelled encounter
  k : ℕ        -- water grabs with species-positive eDNA
  nG : ℕ       -- total water grabs
  gC : Grid    -- per-grab false-positive (contamination) probability when absent
  gT : Grid    -- per-grab detection probability when present

/-- Prior law of `N`: `P(N=0)=1-ω`; given presence `P(N=n) ∝ 1/n` on `1..M`. -/
noncomputable def spPrior (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n = 0 then 1 - s.omega else s.omega * (1 / (n : ℝ)) / harm s.M

/-- Law of the number of false labels. -/
def spPF (s : Sp) : ℕ → ℝ := fun f => (gridAvg s.gF) (fun p => binomPmf s.m p f)
/-- Law of the number of true encounters given `N = n`. -/
def spPT (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => (gridAvg s.gQ) (fun q => binomPmf (s.c * n) q t)
/-- Likelihood of observing `y` camera labels given `N = n`: false labels + true encounters. -/
def spCamLik (s : Sp) (n y : ℕ) : ℝ := conv s.m (s.c * n) (spPF s) ((spPT s) n) y

/-- Probability of the observed eDNA grab pattern given absent / present. -/
def pattern (k nG : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ := p ^ k * (1 - p) ^ (nG - k)
noncomputable def spEdnaLik (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if n = 0 then (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) else (gridAvg s.gT) (pattern s.k s.nG)

/-- Unnormalised posterior and evidence. -/
noncomputable def spUnnorm (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (spPrior s) n * (spCamLik s) n s.y * (spEdnaLik s) n
noncomputable def spZ (s : Sp) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range (s.M + 1), (spUnnorm s) n
/-- Posterior law of the number of individuals (Bayes' rule). -/
noncomputable def spPost (s : Sp) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (spUnnorm s) n / (spZ s)

/-- Presence means at least one living individual. -/
noncomputable def spPresence (s : Sp) : ℝ := ∑ n ∈ range (s.M + 1), if 0 < n then (spPost s) n else 0

structure SpValid (s : Sp) : Prop where
  M_pos : 1 ≤ s.M
  omega_pos : 0 < s.omega
  omega_lt : s.omega < 1
  gF : (GridPos s.gF)
  gQ : (GridPos s.gQ)
  gC : (GridPos s.gC)
  gT : (GridPos s.gT)
  gFo : (GridOk s.gF)
  gQo : (GridOk s.gQ)
  gCo : (GridOk s.gC)
  gTo : (GridOk s.gT)
  y_le : s.y ≤ s.c * s.M
  nG_ge : s.k ≤ s.nG

theorem harm_pos {M : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ M) : 0 < harm M := by
  unfold harm
  refine Finset.sum_pos (fun k _ => by positivity) ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr h⟩

theorem prior_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : IsLaw s.M (spPrior s) := by
  have hH := harm_pos h.M_pos
  constructor
  · intro n
    unfold spPrior
    split_ifs
    · linarith [h.omega_lt]
    · have := h.omega_pos; positivity
  · rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [spPrior]
    simp only [Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, if_true]
    have : ∑ i ∈ range s.M, s.omega * (1 / (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) / harm s.M = s.omega := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.mul_sum]
      have : ∑ i ∈ range s.M, (1 / (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) = harm s.M := by
        unfold harm; push_cast; rfl
      rw [this]; field_simp
    rw [this]; ring

theorem pF_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : IsLaw s.m (spPF s) :=
  mix_isLaw h.gFo (fun i hi => binomPmf_isLaw s.m (h.gFo.x_mem i hi).1 (h.gFo.x_mem i hi).2)

theorem pT_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : IsLaw (s.c * n) ((spPT s) n) :=
  mix_isLaw h.gQo (fun i hi => binomPmf_isLaw (s.c * n) (h.gQo.x_mem i hi).1 (h.gQo.x_mem i hi).2)

/-- The camera likelihood is a genuine probability law for the data `y` given `N = n`. -/
theorem camLik_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) :
    IsLaw (s.m + s.c * n) (fun y => (spCamLik s) n y) :=
  conv_isLaw (pF_isLaw h) (pT_isLaw h n)

theorem ednaLik_nonneg {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (spEdnaLik s) n := by
  unfold spEdnaLik
  have key : ∀ g : Grid, (GridOk g) → 0 ≤ (gridAvg g) (pattern s.k s.nG) := by
    intro g hg
    refine (gridAvg_nonneg g) hg.w_nonneg (fun i hi => ?_)
    have := hg.x_mem i hi
    unfold pattern
    have : 0 ≤ 1 - g.x i := by linarith [this.2]
    have := (hg.x_mem i hi).1
    positivity
  split_ifs
  · exact key _ h.gCo
  · exact key _ h.gTo

theorem ednaLik_pos {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : 0 < (spEdnaLik s) n := by
  unfold spEdnaLik
  have key : ∀ g : Grid, (GridPos g) → 0 < (gridAvg g) (pattern s.k s.nG) := by
    intro g hg
    refine (gridAvg_pos g) hg (fun i hi => ?_)
    have := hg.x_in i hi
    unfold pattern
    have : 0 < 1 - g.x i := by linarith [this.2]
    have := (hg.x_in i hi).1
    positivity
  split_ifs
  · exact key _ h.gC
  · exact key _ h.gT

theorem unnorm_nonneg {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (spUnnorm s) n := by
  unfold spUnnorm
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ((prior_isLaw h).nonneg n) ((camLik_isLaw h n).nonneg _))
    (ednaLik_nonneg h n)

theorem conv_pos {M1 M2 : ℕ} {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hb : ∀ n, 0 ≤ b n)
    (ha0 : 0 < a 0) {y : ℕ} (hy : y ≤ M2) (hby : 0 < b y) : 0 < conv M1 M2 a b y := by
  unfold conv
  have h0 : 0 ∈ range (M1 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos _)
  have hyr : y ∈ range (M2 + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hy)
  have inner_nn : ∀ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1),
      (if i + j = y then a i * b j else 0) := fun i _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs; exact mul_nonneg (ha i) (hb j); exact le_refl _)
  have h1 := Finset.single_le_sum inner_nn h0
  have h2 := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => if 0 + j = y then a 0 * b j else 0)
    (fun j _ => by split_ifs; exact mul_nonneg (ha 0) (hb j); exact le_refl _) hyr
  simp only [zero_add, if_true] at h2
  have : 0 < a 0 * b y := mul_pos ha0 hby
  simp only [zero_add] at h1
  linarith

theorem camLik_pos {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : 0 < (spCamLik s) s.M s.y := by
  unfold spCamLik
  have hF0 : 0 < (spPF s) 0 := by
    refine (gridAvg_pos s.gF) h.gF (fun i hi => binomPmf_pos s.m (h.gF.x_in i hi).1 (h.gF.x_in i hi).2 (Nat.zero_le _))
  have hT : 0 < (spPT s) s.M s.y :=
    (gridAvg_pos s.gQ) h.gQ (fun i hi => binomPmf_pos _ (h.gQ.x_in i hi).1 (h.gQ.x_in i hi).2 h.y_le)
  exact conv_pos (pF_isLaw h).nonneg (pT_isLaw h s.M).nonneg hF0 h.y_le hT

/-- The data are possible under the model: the evidence is strictly positive. -/
theorem Z_pos {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : 0 < (spZ s) := by
  unfold spZ
  have hH := harm_pos h.M_pos
  refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun n _ => unnorm_nonneg h n) ⟨s.M, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self _), ?_⟩
  unfold spUnnorm spPrior
  have hM : s.M ≠ 0 := by have := h.M_pos; omega
  simp only [hM, if_false]
  have := h.omega_pos
  have hMr : (0 : ℝ) < s.M := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hM
  have := camLik_pos h
  have := ednaLik_pos h s.M
  positivity

/-- The posterior is a probability law on `{0,…,M}`. -/
theorem post_isLaw {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) : IsLaw s.M (spPost s) := by
  have hZ := Z_pos h
  constructor
  · intro n; exact div_nonneg (unnorm_nonneg h n) hZ.le
  · unfold spPost
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self hZ.ne'

/-- Posterior probability of presence (`N > 0`) is `1 - P(N = 0 | data)`, with the explicit form of
`P(N=0 | data)`. -/
theorem presence_formula {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) :
    (spPresence s) = 1 - (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s) := by
  have hl := (post_isLaw h).sum_one
  unfold spPresence
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at hl ⊢
  simp only [Nat.succ_pos, if_true, lt_self_iff_false, if_false, add_zero] at hl ⊢
  have h0 : (spPost s) 0 = (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s) := by
    simp [spPost, spUnnorm, spPrior, spEdnaLik]
  linarith

/-- With no camera false labels possible, one labelled encounter excludes absence. -/
theorem camera_excludes_absence {s : Sp} (h : (SpValid s)) (hy : 0 < s.y)
    (hnofp : ∀ i, i < s.gF.K → s.gF.x i = 0) : (spPresence s) = 1 := by
  rw [presence_formula h]
  have hz : (spCamLik s) 0 s.y = 0 := by
    unfold spCamLik conv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hjm => ?_))
    have hj : j = 0 := by simp at hjm; omega
    split_ifs with hij
    · have hi : i ≠ 0 := by omega
      have : (spPF s) i = 0 := by
        unfold spPF gridAvg
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun l hl => ?_)
        rw [hnofp l (Finset.mem_range.mp hl)]
        simp [binomPmf, hi]
      rw [this, zero_mul]
    · rfl
  rw [hz]; simp

/-- Independence: with a product prior and a product likelihood, the joint posterior of two
species is the product of the marginal posteriors. -/
theorem joint_posterior_factorizes {M1 M2 : ℕ} {pa pb la lb : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hZa : ∑ i ∈ range (M1 + 1), pa i * la i ≠ 0) (hZb : ∑ j ∈ range (M2 + 1), pb j * lb j ≠ 0)
    (i j : ℕ) :
    (pa i * pb j * (la i * lb j)) /
        ∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pa i' * pb j' * (la i' * lb j') =
      ((pa i * la i) / ∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), pa i' * la i') *
        ((pb j * lb j) / ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pb j' * lb j') := by
  have : ∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pa i' * pb j' * (la i' * lb j') =
      (∑ i' ∈ range (M1 + 1), pa i' * la i') * ∑ j' ∈ range (M2 + 1), pb j' * lb j' := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j' _ => ?_))
    ring
  rw [this]
  field_simp

/-! ### Total population -/

/-- Law (support bound, pmf) of the total of a list of independent species counts. -/
noncomputable def totalLaw : List Sp → ℕ × (ℕ → ℝ)
  | [] => (0, fun n => if n = 0 then 1 else 0)
  | s :: ss => (s.M + (totalLaw ss).1, conv s.M (totalLaw ss).1 (spPost s) (totalLaw ss).2)

theorem totalLaw_spec : ∀ l : List Sp, (∀ s ∈ l, (SpValid s)) →
    IsLaw (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 ∧
    mean (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => mean s.M (spPost s))).sum ∧
    var (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => var s.M (spPost s))).sum
  | [], _ => by
    refine ⟨⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [totalLaw]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
    · simp [totalLaw]
    · simp [totalLaw, mean, E]
    · simp [totalLaw, var, E, mean]
  | s :: ss, hv => by
    have hs : (SpValid s) := hv s (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := totalLaw_spec ss (fun t ht => hv t (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ht))
    have hl := post_isLaw hs
    refine ⟨conv_isLaw hl h1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [totalLaw, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [mean_conv hl h1, h2]
    · simp only [totalLaw, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [var_conv hl h1, h3]

/-- **Answer.** For independent species counts whose posteriors are defined by the Bayesian model
above: each species posterior is a probability law, its presence probability is given by the
explicit formula, a labelled camera encounter excludes absence when no false labels are possible,
and the total population posterior is the convolution of the species laws, a probability law
whose mean and variance are the sums of the species means and variances. -/
theorem answer_theorem : ∀ l : List Sp, (∀ s ∈ l, (SpValid s)) →
    (∀ s ∈ l, IsLaw s.M (spPost s) ∧
      (spPresence s) = 1 - (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s)) ∧
    IsLaw (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 ∧
    mean (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => mean s.M (spPost s))).sum ∧
    var (totalLaw l).1 (totalLaw l).2 = (l.map (fun s => var s.M (spPost s))).sum := by
  intro l hv
  exact ⟨fun s hs => ⟨post_isLaw (hv s hs), presence_formula (hv s hs)⟩, totalLaw_spec l hv⟩

/-! ### The lake: data and explicit modelling choices -/

/-- Rescale the parameters of a grid by a factor `a` (used for transfer/coverage). -/
def scaledGrid (g : Grid) (a : ℝ) : Grid where
  K := g.K
  w := g.w
  x := fun i => a * g.x i

theorem scaledGrid_pos {g : Grid} (hg : (GridPos g)) {a : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < a) (h1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (GridPos (scaledGrid g a)) := by
  refine ⟨hg.K_pos, hg.w_pos, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have := hg.x_in i hi
  show 0 < a * g.x i ∧ a * g.x i < 1
  constructor
  · exact mul_pos h0 this.1
  · nlinarith [this.1, this.2]

theorem scaledGrid_ok {g : Grid} (hg : (GridOk g)) {a : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ a) (h1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (GridOk (scaledGrid g a)) := by
  refine ⟨hg.w_nonneg, hg.w_sum, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  have := hg.x_mem i hi
  show 0 ≤ a * g.x i ∧ a * g.x i ≤ 1
  constructor
  · exact mul_nonneg h0 this.1
  · nlinarith [this.1, this.2]

/-- Fraction of the mapped lake area (57 782.56 m²) covered by the 9 camera footprints (1260 m²)
of one pass. -/
noncomputable def coverFrac : ℝ := 1260 / 57782.56

theorem coverFrac_bounds : 0 < coverFrac ∧ coverFrac < 1 := by
  unfold coverFrac; constructor <;> norm_num

/-- One panel species.  `om` prior presence probability; `y` camera labels; `calHits` correct
labels out of 160 reference encounters; `fpHits` false labels in 200 fish-free reference videos;
`k` eDNA-positive grabs of 18; `tau` field/reference detectability transfer factor. -/
noncomputable def mkSp (om : ℝ) (y calHits fpHits k : ℕ) (tau : ℝ) : Sp where
  M := 100000
  omega := om
  y := y
  m := 36
  c := 2
  gF := calGrid 20 fpHits 200
  gQ := scaledGrid (calGrid 20 calHits 160) (coverFrac * tau)
  k := k
  nG := 18
  gC := calGrid 20 1 16
  gT := flatGrid 20

/-- The eight panel species, in order: perch, roach, ruffe, pike, burbot, bleak, vendace, bream. -/
noncomputable def lakeSpecies (tau : ℝ) : List Sp :=
  [ mkSp (97 / 100) 39 97 2 17 tau, mkSp (9 / 10) 26 82 2 17 tau,
    mkSp (8 / 10) 1 29 1 14 tau, mkSp (9 / 10) 1 67 6 9 tau,
    mkSp (6 / 10) 1 24 4 1 tau, mkSp (35 / 100) 0 92 1 1 tau,
    mkSp (3 / 10) 0 78 3 0 tau, mkSp (35 / 100) 1 75 2 1 tau ]

theorem mkSp_valid {om : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < om) (h1 : om < 1) {y : ℕ} (hy : y ≤ 200000)
    (calHits fpHits : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ 18) {tau : ℝ} (t0 : 0 < tau) (t1 : tau ≤ 1) :
    (SpValid (mkSp om y calHits fpHits k tau)) := by
  have hc := coverFrac_bounds
  have ha0 : 0 < coverFrac * tau := mul_pos hc.1 t0
  have ha1 : coverFrac * tau ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [hc.2]
  have k20 : 0 < 20 := by norm_num
  have kk : 0 < 16 := by norm_num
  have hM : 1 ≤ (100000 : ℕ) := by norm_num
  have hy' : y ≤ 2 * 100000 := by omega
  exact ⟨hM, h0, h1,
    calGrid_pos 20 _ _ k20, scaledGrid_pos (calGrid_pos 20 _ _ k20) ha0 ha1,
    calGrid_pos 20 _ _ k20, flatGrid_pos 20 k20,
    calGrid_ok 20 _ _ k20, scaledGrid_ok (calGrid_ok 20 _ _ k20) ha0.le ha1,
    calGrid_ok 20 _ _ k20, flatGrid_ok 20 k20,
    hy', hk⟩

theorem lake_valid {tau : ℝ} (t0 : 0 < tau) (t1 : tau ≤ 1) : ∀ s ∈ lakeSpecies tau, (SpValid s) := by
  intro s hs
  simp only [lakeSpecies, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    exact mkSp_valid (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _ _ (by norm_num) t0 t1

/-- **Conclusion for the lake.**  For every field/reference detectability transfer factor
`tau ∈ (0,1]`: each panel species' posterior count law is a probability law on `{0..100000}` with
presence probability `1 - P(N=0 | data)` given by the explicit formula, and the posterior law of
the total panel-species count (independent species) is a probability law whose mean and variance
are the sums of the eight species posterior means and variances. -/
theorem lake_answer : ∀ tau : ℝ, 0 < tau → tau ≤ 1 →
    (∀ s ∈ lakeSpecies tau, IsLaw s.M (spPost s) ∧
      (spPresence s) = 1 - (1 - s.omega) * (spCamLik s) 0 s.y * (gridAvg s.gC) (pattern s.k s.nG) / (spZ s)) ∧
    IsLaw (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).1 (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).2 ∧
    mean (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).1 (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).2
      = ((lakeSpecies tau).map (fun s => mean s.M (spPost s))).sum ∧
    var (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).1 (totalLaw (lakeSpecies tau)).2
      = ((lakeSpecies tau).map (fun s => var s.M (spPost s))).sum :=
  fun _ t0 t1 => answer_theorem _ (lake_valid t0 t1)

NAME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9']*")


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def directory_fd(path, create=False):
    """Walk from root without following links, even in an untrusted workspace."""
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    if ".." in path.parts:
        raise ValueError("directory traversal is unsupported")
    fd = os.open("/", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        for part in path.parts[1:]:
            if create:
                try:
                    os.mkdir(part, mode=0o700, dir_fd=fd)
                except FileExistsError:
                    pass
            child = os.open(part, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
            os.close(fd)
            fd = child
        return fd
    except BaseException:
        os.close(fd)
        raise


def ensure_directory(path):
    os.close(directory_fd(path, create=True))

{
  "command": "cd /work/v4; cat > gen.py <<'EOF'\nimport math, sys\nfrom fractions import Fraction as Fr\nsys.path.insert(0,'/work/v4')\nfrom data import Y, hits, area, foot, wilson, sp, hab, sz\nA={h:Fr(str(area[h])) for h in hab}\ndef rnd(x,up):\n    x=Fr(x).limit_denominator(10**9)\n    f=x*100\n    return Fr(math.ceil(f) if up else math.floor(f),100)\ncells={}\nfor s in sp:\n    L=[]\n    for h in hab:\n        for z in sz:\n            lo,hi=wilson(hits[(s,z)],80)\n            L.append(dict(y=Y[(s,h,z)],g=Fr(6*foot[h])/A[h],A=A[h],dlo=rnd(lo,False),dhi=rnd(hi,True)))\n    cells[s]=L\ndef lit(q):\n    q=Fr(q)\n    return f\"({q.numerator} / {q.denominator} : ℝ)\" if q.denominator!=1 else f\"({q.numerator} : ℝ)\"\ndef meanR(y,r): return (y+1)*r/(1-r)+y\ndef varR(y,r): return (y+1)*r/(1-r)**2\ndef rLo(c,th,kl): return (1-1/(1+kl*c['A']))*(1-c['g']*th*c['dhi'])\ndef rHi(c,tl,kh): return (1-1/(1+kh*c['A']))*(1-c['g']*tl*c['dlo'])\ndef box(cs,tl,th,kl,kh):\n    return (sum(meanR(c['y'],rLo(c,th,kl)) for c in cs), sum(meanR(c['y'],rHi(c,tl,kh)) for c in cs), sum(varR(c['y'],rHi(c,tl,kh)) for c in cs))\nscen=[('full',Fr(1,4),Fr(1),Fr(1,20),Fr(5)),('tau1',Fr(1),Fr(1),Fr(1,20),Fr(5)),('tauhalf',Fr(1,2),Fr(1,2),Fr(1,20),Fr(5)),('tauquarter',Fr(1,4),Fr(1,4),Fr(1,20),Fr(5))]\ngroups=[('perchC',cells['perch']),('roachC',cells['roach']),('ruffeC',cells['ruffe']),('pikeC',cells['pike']),('lakeC',sum(cells.values(),[]))]\nout={}\nfor name,tl,th,kl,kh in scen:\n    for g,cs in groups:\n        lo,hi,v=box(cs,tl,th,kl,kh)\n        Lb=Fr(math.floor(lo)); Ub=Fr(math.ceil(hi)); Vb=Fr(math.ceil(v))\n        c=Fr(math.ceil(math.sqrt(10*float(Vb))))\n        while c*c<10*Vb: c+=1\n        out[(name,g)]=dict(Lb=Lb,Ub=Ub,Vb=Vb,c=c,Lc=Lb-c,Uc=Ub+c,lo=float(lo),hi=float(hi),v=float(v))\nif __name__=='__main__':\n    for k,v in out.items(): print(k,{a:(round(b,1) if isinstance(b,float) else str(b)) for a,b in v.items()})\nEOF\npython3 gen.py"
}

its mean lies in `[Lb,Ub]`; its variance is `≤ Vb`; it puts no mass below\nthe number of labelled encounters; and the interval `(Lc,Uc)` has probability `≥ 0.9`. -/\ndef Summary (cs : List Cell) (τ κ : ℝ) (d : Cell → ℝ) (Lb Ub Vb Lc Uc : ℝ) : Prop :=\n  Law (lawOf (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d))) (M1 (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)))\n      (V (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) + M1 (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) ^ 2) ∧\n  Lb ≤ M1 (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) ∧ M1 (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) ≤ Ub ∧\n  V (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) ≤ Vb ∧\n  (∀ n : ℕ, n < (cs.map (fun c => c.y)).sum → lawOf (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) n = 0) ∧\n  9 / 10 ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, (if Lc < (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) < Uc then lawOf (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) n else 0)\n\ntheorem summary_of_box {τl τh κl κh : ℝ} (hb : Box τl τh κl κh) {cs : List Cell}\n    (hok : ∀ c ∈ cs, CellOk c) {τ κ : ℝ} (hτ : τl ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ τh) (hκ : κl ≤ κ ∧ κ ≤ κh)\n    {d : Cell → ℝ} (hd : ∀ c ∈ cs, c.dlo ≤ d c ∧ d c ≤ c.dhi)\n    {Lb Ub Vb Lc Uc c : ℝ} (h1 : Lb ≤ boxLo τh κl cs) (h2 : boxHi τl κh cs ≤ Ub)\n    (h3 : boxV τl κh cs ≤ Vb) (hc : 0 < c) (hc2 : 10 * Vb ≤ c ^ 2) (hL : Lc ≤ Lb - c)\n    (hU : Ub + c ≤ Uc) : Summary cs τ κ d Lb Ub Vb Lc Uc := by\n  obtain ⟨ok, lo, hi, vb, ys⟩ := list_box hb cs hok hτ hκ hd\n  have hl := lawOf_law _ ok\n  refine ⟨hl, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩\n  · intro n hn\n    exact lawOf_below _ ok n (by rw [ys]; exact hn)\n  · have hch := cheb_interval hl hc (L := Lc) (U := Uc) (by linarith) (by linarith)\n    have e : V (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) + M1 (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) ^ 2 - M1 (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) ^ 2\n        = V (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) := by ring\n    rw [e] at hch\n    have hc2' : 0 < c ^ 2 := by positivity\n    have : V (cs.map (fitOf τ κ d)) / c ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10 := by\n      rw [div_le_iff₀ hc2']; linarith\n    linarith\n\ntheorem lake_cells_ok : ∀ c ∈ lakeC, CellOk c := by\n  simp only [lakeC, perchC, roachC, ruffeC, pikeC, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]\n  intro c hc\n  rcases hc with ((hc | hc) | hc) | hc <;>\n  rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [CellOk]\n'''\ndef stmt(name,tl,th,kl,kh):\n    r=lambda g:out[(name,g)]\n    parts=[]\n    for g,_ in groups:\n        o=r(g)\n        parts.append(f\"Summary {g} τ κ d {lit(o['Lb'])} {lit(o['Ub'])} {lit(o['Vb'])} {lit(o['Lc'])} {lit(o['Uc'])}\")\n    return parts\nfor name,tl,th,kl,kh in scen:\n    parts=stmt(name,tl,th,kl,kh)\n    s+=f'''\ntheorem answer_{name} : ∀ (τ κ : ℝ) (d : Cell → ℝ), {lit(tl)} ≤ τ → τ ≤ {lit(th)} → {lit(kl)} ≤ κ → κ ≤ {lit(kh)} →\n    (∀ c ∈ lakeC, c.dlo ≤ d c ∧ d c ≤ c.dhi) →\n    {\" ∧\\n    \".join(parts)} := by\n  intro τ κ d t1 t2 k1 k2 hd\n  have hb : Box {lit(tl)} {lit(th)} {lit(kl)} {lit(kh)} := by\n    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> norm_num\n  have hok := lake_cells_ok\n'''\n    sub={'perchC':'(fun c hc => hok c (by simp [lakeC, hc]))','roachC':'(fun c hc => hok c (by simp [lakeC, hc]))','ruffeC':'(fun c hc => hok c (by simp [lakeC, hc]))','pikeC':'(fun c hc => hok c (by simp [lakeC, hc]))','lakeC':'hok'}\n    lines=[]\n    for g,_ in groups:\n        o=out[(name,g)]\n        hdarg = \"(fun c hc => hd c (by simp [lakeC, hc]))\" if g!='lakeC' else \"hd\"\n        lines.append(f\"summary_of_box hb {sub[g]} ⟨t1, t2⟩ ⟨k1, k2⟩ {hdarg} (c := {lit(o['c'])})\\n      (by norm_num [boxLo, rLo, meanR, {g}]) (by norm_num [boxHi, rHi, meanR, {g}])\\n      (by norm_num [boxV, rHi, varR, {g}]) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)\")\n    s+=\"  exact ⟨\"+\",\\n    \".join(lines)+\"⟩\\n\"\nopen('G.lean','w').write(s)\nEOF\npython3 gen2.py && cat A.lean B.lean C.lean D.lean E.lean F.lean G.lean > ALL.lean; PRESENCE (option (b) authorised by the reviewer): the four species perch, roach, ruffe and pike are\n   ASSUMED present (≥ 1 living individual); the count inference below is made for these four species only.\n   Presence of burbot, bleak, vendace, common bream and non-panel taxa is not assessed, and their fish are\n   NOT in any total.  `Summary` additionally proves that, if the camera labels are correct, the posterior\n   has no mass below the number of labels, so those four species are then certainly present.\n2. Cells = species × habitat (littoral/open/deep) × size bin (≤ 8 cm / > 8 cm); cell counts are a priori\n   independent.  Prior of a cell: `N ~ Geometric(ρ)` = Gamma(shape 1)–Poisson marginal with prior mean\n   `κ·A` fish (`κ` fish per m², `A` the mapped habitat area).  `κ` is not identifiable: we let it range over\n   [0.05, 5] fish/m² (≈ 5–500 fish per 100 m²; boreal-lake fish biomass of order 10–300 kg/ha spread\n   over fish of 5–50 g) and prove the conclusions for every value in that range.\n3. Observation: each fish of the cell is independently labelled by the cameras with probability\n   `p = g·τ·d`  (g = 6·footprint/area = fraction covered in 2 passes × 3 stations; d = reference-video\n   detection probability; τ = field/reference transfer factor).  `y ~ Binomial(N, p)`.  This treats the two\n   passes as one trial with probability 2×(per-pass) (accurate when p ≪ 1; here p ≤ 0.1), ignores\n   repeat encounters of the same fish, treats the mapped areas as exact and assumes fish are spread\n   uniformly inside a habitat/size cell.  Camera false labels are not modelled (≤ 4 % per fish-free\n   video; they would lower the means slightly, most for the y = 1 ruffe and pike cells).\n4. `d` is allowed to lie anywhere in the 95 % Wilson interval of its calibration (rounded outward), per cell;\n   `τ` is NOT identifiable: reported as scenarios τ = 1, 1/2, 1/4 and as the envelope τ ∈ [1/4, 1].\n   The results are therefore ENVELOPES over a parameter box, not a posterior over τ, d, κ.\n5. The total is the sum of independent cell counts (independence of cells given the parameters).\n\n## Proved (see theorems)\n* `cell_post_law`: from the geometric prior and binomial likelihood by Bayes' rule, the evidence is\n  explicit and the posterior of `N` is `y +` NegBin(y+1, r = (1-ρ)(1-p)), a probability law with\n  mean `(y+1)r/(1-r)+y` and variance `(y+1)r/(1-r)²` (normalisation and moment series proved).\n* `lawOf_law`: the total over independent cells is the convolution; its mean / variance are the sums.\n* `cheb_interval`: Chebyshev interval for a law with given moments.\n* `answer_full`, `answer_tau1`, `answer_tauhalf`, `answer_tauquarter`: for EVERY κ, τ and\n  detection `d` in the stated box, the species laws (perch, roach, ruffe, pike) and the total law are\n  probability laws whose means lie in the stated numeric intervals, whose variances are ≤ the stated bound,\n  with no mass below the number of labels and with ≥ 90 % probability in the stated interval.\n  (`Summary` spells out each of these claims.)\n-/\n\n'''\ns=s[:i]+hdr+s[i+len(\"open Finset\\n\"):]\nopen('/work/Model.lean','w').write(s)\nEOF\ncd /work; grep -c \"\" Model.lean; python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport sys\nsys.path.insert(0,'/work/v4')\nfrom gen import *\nfor k,v in out.items():\n    print(k, v['Lb'],v['Ub'],v['Vb'], round(v['Vb']**.5**1 if False else float(v['Vb'])**.5), v['Lc'],v['Uc'])\nEOF"

The model was changed to a conjugate family whose posterior is closed form, so every\n   reported mean, variance bound, and interval is a Lean theorem (answer_full / answer_tau1 / answer_tauhalf / answer_tauquarter),\n   obtained by monotonicity in the nuisance parameters plus norm_num on exact rational data. Python (v4/gen.py) only proposed the bounds.\n2. Presence: option (b). Burbot, bleak, vendace, common bream (and non-panel fish) are not assessed and are not in any total.\n   Lean also proves: if the camera labels are correct, the posterior has no mass below the number of labels, so these species are then certainly present.\n3. Cycle-3 derivations kept: normalised laws, convolution total with additive mean/variance, camera evidence excluding N=0, now for infinite-support laws.\n   The finite-grid / 1/n-prior / 20-point grid machinery was replaced.\n\nMODEL (choices exposed in the Lean header)\n cell = species x habitat x size bin (24 cells); prior N ~ Geometric(rho) (Gamma(1)-Poisson marginal), prior mean kappa*A fish, kappa in [0.05,5] fish/m2 (unidentified, range justified roughly from boreal-lake fish biomass);\n y ~ Binomial(N, p), p = (6*footprint/area) * tau * d, d = reference-video detection (95% Wilson interval, rounded outward), tau = field/reference transfer (UNIDENTIFIABLE; scenarios 1, 1/2, 1/4 and envelope [1/4,1]);\n cells independent. eDNA and sonar are not used for counts.\n Proved: posterior of N is y + NegBin(y+1, r=(1-rho)(1-p)); mean (y+1)r/(1-r)+y; variance (y+1)r/(1-r)^2; the total is the convolution.\n\nPROVED RESULTS (every kappa in [0.05,5], every d in its interval; posterior MEAN bound / variance bound / sd bound; Chebyshev: (Lc,Uc) has prob >= 0.9)\n envelope tau in [1/4,1]: perch 1431-8941, roach 1205-8400, ruffe 605-8922, pike 317-2659; TOTAL of the 4 species 3560-28920 (var <= 2.10e7, sd <= 4581; P(N < 43408) >= 0.9)\n tau = 1  : perch 1431-2236, roach 1205-2101, ruffe 605-2253, pike 317-663;  total 3560-7251 (sd <= 1154; interval (-90,10901) prob >= 0.9)\n tau = 1/2: perch 2767-4474, roach 2313-4204, ruffe 1113-4493, pike 611-1330; total 6806-14499 (sd <= 2304; (-480,21785))\n tau = 1/4: perch 5176-8941, roach 4273-8400, ruffe 1914-8922, pike 1126-2659; total 12491-28920 (sd <= 4581; (-1997,43408))\n The Chebyshev intervals are conservative and their lower ends are non-positive, so in practice they are upper limits.\n The spread across tau (factor ~4) dominates; tau cannot be learned from these data (needs a paired field/reference test).\n\nLIMITATIONS / FOR REVIEW\n - The envelopes are over a parameter box, not a posterior over tau, d, kappa. Cells with y=0 get posterior mass from the geometric prior (roughly 1/p); ruffe and pike totals are driven by this.\n - Presence is an assumption (b); for pike (1 label, 3% false-label rate, eDNA 9/18 grabs) and ruffe (1 label) camera labels may be false; false labels are not modelled.\n - Two passes pooled as one binomial with doubled probability; re-detections ignored; mapped areas exact (sd ~3%); uniform spread within a cell; cells independent.\n - Quantity: living fish of these four species in the mapped strata (littoral/open/deep) in the late-August window. It is a LOWER-type estimate of the lake total: other species, unmapped habitat and small fish below detection are excluded.\n - kappa range is a weakly informative judgement, exposed not inferred; proofs hold for every value in the range.\nEOF\ncat > candidate.json <<'EOF'\n{\n \"proof_file\": \"Model.lean\",\n \"narrative_file\": \"report.txt\",\n \"conclusions\": {\n  \"posterior_derivation\": \"cell_post_law\",\n  \"answer_envelope\": \"answer_full\",\n  \"answer_tau1\": \"answer_tau1\",\n  \"answer_tauhalf\": \"answer_tauhalf\",\n  \"answer_tauquarter\": \"answer_tauquarter\"\n },\n \"user_facts\": [\n  \"SYNTHETIC survey VCS-LK-001 (sha256 2b91b221e0145c57f1b2f0462166173ea82e222f9735f9e17808ffd52f9ace80): camera labels per species/habitat/size bin, footprints, mapped areas, reference-video calibration hits/80\",\n  \"No fish may be caught; true populations unknown; reference panel is not a presence list\",\n  \"Reviewer authorised presence handling (b): treat presence as probability 1 for the species whose population is estimated, stated explicitly;     # backtick name literals and quotations are metaprogramming, which a proof body never needs (OT-1861)

def strip_comments(source):
    out, i, depth = [], 0, 0
    while i < len(source):
        if source.startswith("/-", i):
            depth += 1
            i += 2
        elif depth and source.startswith("-/", i):
            depth -= 1
            i += 2
        elif depth:
            i += 1
        elif source.startswith("--", i):
            j = source.find("\n", i)
            i = len(source) if j == -1 else j
            out.append("\n")
        else:
            out.append(source[i])
            i += 1
    if depth:
        raise ValueError("Unclosed Lean comment")
    return "".join(out)


def validate(source, required):
    if not isinstance(source, str) or not 0 < len(source.encode()) <= 24000:
        raise ValueError("Lean body must contain at most 24000 UTF-8 bytes")
    code = strip_comments(source)
    if '"' in code:
        raise ValueError("Put prose in comments; executable strings are outside this contract")
    code = re.sub(r"^\s*set_option (maxRecDepth|maxHeartbeats) \d+\s*$", "", code, flags=re.M)
    if re.search(r"\bset_option\b", code):
        raise ValueError("Only maxRecDepth/maxHeartbeats options are available")
    if "VAS_" in code:
        raise ValueError("Names containing VAS_ are reserved for the checker's own report")
    bad = FORBIDDEN.search(code)
    if bad:
        raise ValueError(f"Outside the restricted Lean contract: {bad.group()}")
    if re.search(r"\b(?:def|abbrev|theorem|lemma|structure|inductive|class)\s+[^\s:(]+\.", code):
        raise ValueError("Declare plain top-level names; namespaces are outside this contract")
    theorems = re.findall(r"^\s*(?:theorem|lemma)\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9']*)", code, re.M)
    missing = [n for n in required if n not in theorems]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required theorems: {missing}")
    if re.search(r"\baxiom\b(?!\s+[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9']*\s*[:({\[])", code):
        raise ValueError("Declare an added assumption as `axiom name : statement` at the start of a line")
    return theorems

private partial def VAS_unstated : Lean.Expr → Bool
  | e@(.app ..) =>

  | .mdata _ b | .proj _ _ b => VAS_unstated b
  | _ => false

  let mut todo : List Name := ROOTS
  while !todo.isEmpty do
    let n := todo.head!
    todo := todo.tail!
    if used.contains n then continue
    used := used.insert n
    if let some ci := kenv.find? n then
      for e in exprsOf ci do
        for c in e.getUsedConstants do
          if localSet.contains c && !used.contains c then todo := c :: todo
  for (n, ci) in locals do
    if let .axiomInfo _ := ci then
      logInfo m!"VAS_AXIOM {n} used={used.contains n} : {← liftTermElabM <| ppExpr ci.type} VAS_END"
    -- every declaration kind, type and value: a gap may sit in an axiom's type as well as in a proof
    for e in exprsOf ci do
      -- hasSorry is cached and linear; VAS_unstated walks the term as a tree, exponential on shared proofs
      if e.hasSorry && VAS_unstated e then
        logInfo m!"VAS_GAP {n} used={used.contains n} : (sorry with no stated goal: it can assert anything) VAS_END"
        logInfo m!"VAS_UNSTATED {n} used={used.contains n}"
    if (exprsOf ci).any (·.hasSorry) then

"""Restricted Lean validation and kernel-environment assumption audit.

Stable VAS_ audit markers preserve compatibility with recorded evidence.
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
_TOOLCHAIN = (ROOT / "lean-toolchain").read_text().strip().replace("/", "--").replace(":", "---")
LEAN = os.environ.get("VAS_LEAN") or str(Path(os.environ.get("ELAN_HOME", Path.home() / ".elan")) / "toolchains" / _TOOLCHAIN / "bin/lean")
LEANCHECKER = str(Path(LEAN).with_name("leanchecker"))
ALLOWED_AXIOMS = {"propext", "Classical.choice", "Quot.sound"}
FORBIDDEN = re.compile(
    r"\b(axioms|native_decide|implemented_by|extern|unsafe|opaque|import|"
    r"macro|macro_rules|syntax|elab|notation|infix|infixl|infixr|prefix|postfix|"
    r"run_cmd|run_tac|run_elab|run_meta|initialize|builtin_initialize|instance|attribute|"
    r"partial|private|local|scoped|namespace|section|end|universe|variable|export|IO|System|"
    r"Lean|native|simproc|dsimproc)\b"
    # any word containing elab (by_elab, elab_rules, run_elab: `\belab\b` misses them, `_` is a word character);
    # backtick name literals and quotations are metaprogramming, which a proof body never needs (OT-1861)
    r"|\w*elab\w*|`|#|@\[|\$|«|»")

import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Ring.InfiniteSum
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination

open Finset
structure Law (w : ℕ → ℝ) (m1 m2 : ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ w n
  total : HasSum w 1
  first : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * w n) m1
  second : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * w n) m2

def cv (f g : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ kl ∈ antidiagonal t, f kl.1 * g kl.2

def delta0 (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if n = 0 then 1 else 0

def prior (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := ρ * (1 - ρ) ^ n

def lik (p : ℝ) (y n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n.choose y : ℝ) * p ^ y * (1 - p) ^ (n - y)

def unorm (y : ℕ) (p ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := prior ρ n * lik p y n

noncomputable def post (y : ℕ) (p ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := unorm y p ρ n / ∑' m, unorm y p ρ m

noncomputable def meanR (y : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ := ((y : ℝ) + 1) * r / (1 - r) + y

noncomputable def varR (y : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ := ((y : ℝ) + 1) * r / (1 - r) ^ 2

structure Fit where
  y : ℕ
  p : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ

def rr (f : Fit) : ℝ := (1 - f.ρ) * (1 - f.p)

noncomputable def lawOf : List Fit → ℕ → ℝ
  | [] => delta0
  | f :: fs => cv (post f.y f.p f.ρ) (lawOf fs)

noncomputable def M1 (l : List Fit) : ℝ := (l.map (fun f => meanR f.y (rr f))).sum

noncomputable def V (l : List Fit) : ℝ := (l.map (fun f => varR f.y (rr f))).sum

/-- A scenario cell: `y` labels; the labelling probability lies in `[plo,phi]` and the prior ratio
in `[qlo,qhi]`. -/
structure Cell where
  y : ℕ
  plo : ℝ
  phi : ℝ
  qlo : ℝ
  qhi : ℝ

/-- `P c`, `Q c` are the (unknown) labelling probability and prior ratio of each cell. -/
def Within (cs : List Cell) (P Q : Cell → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ c ∈ cs, c.plo ≤ P c ∧ P c ≤ c.phi ∧ c.qlo ≤ Q c ∧ Q c ≤ c.qhi

def fits (cs : List Cell) (P Q : Cell → ℝ) : List Fit := cs.map (fun c => ⟨c.y, P c, Q c⟩)

/-- Posterior summary of the total of the cells `cs` for every admissible `P`, `Q`: the total law is a
probability law (mean `M1`, variance `V`); `M1 ∈ [Lb,Ub]`, `V ≤ Vb`; no mass below the label count. -/
def Summary (cs : List Cell) (Lb Ub Vb : ℝ) : Prop := ∀ P Q : Cell → ℝ, Within cs P Q →
  Law (lawOf (fits cs P Q)) (M1 (fits cs P Q)) (V (fits cs P Q) + M1 (fits cs P Q) ^ 2) ∧
  Lb ≤ M1 (fits cs P Q) ∧ M1 (fits cs P Q) ≤ Ub ∧ V (fits cs P Q) ≤ Vb ∧
  ∀ n : ℕ, n < (cs.map (fun c => c.y)).sum → lawOf (fits cs P Q) n = 0

- **File size.** The check tool caps the Lean body at 24,000 bytes, so I rebuilt the file compactly. This dropped the Chebyshev interval from the previous draft. The result is claimed as mean ranges and variance bounds only, not population intervals.

**Model** (all choices are exposed in the Lean header and `report.txt`)
- There are 24 independent cells (species × habitat × size bin).
- The prior is N ~ Geometric(ρ), with prior mean κ·A fish and κ in [0.05, 5] fish/m². This κ range is not identifiable from the data.
- Each fish is labelled by the cameras with probability p = (6·footprint/area)·τ·d.
  - d is the reference-video detection, taken from an outward-rounded 95% Wilson interval of hits/80.
  - τ is the field/reference transfer factor, which these data cannot identify.
- eDNA and sonar are not used for abundance.

**Proved in Lean**
- Bayes' rule gives the cell posterior as y plus a negative binomial, with explicit mean (y+1)r/(1−r)+y and variance (y+1)r/(1−r)².
- The total is the convolution of the cell laws, and its mean and variance add.
- No posterior mass lies below the camera label count.
- Posterior mean ranges and variance bounds, for every p and ρ in the stated box:

| Case | Perch | Roach | Ruffe | Pike | Total, four species |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| τ = 1 | 1431–2236 | 1205–2101 | 605–2253 | 317–663 | 3560–7251 |
| τ = 1/2 | 2767–4474 | 2313–4204 | 1113–4493 | 611–1330 | 6806–14499 |
| τ = 1/4 | 5176–8941 | 4273–8400 | 1914–8922 | 1126–2659 | 12491–28920 |
| τ ∈ [1/4, 1] | 1431–8941 | 1205–8400 | 605–8922 | 317–2659 | 3560–28920 |

**For your review**
- The ranges are envelopes over a parameter box, not posterior probabilities for τ, d or κ. The spread across τ (about a factor of 4) dominates the uncertainty.
- Presence is assumed. Pike and ruffe rest on a single camera label each, and camera false labels are not modelled.
- Two passes are pooled into one binomial, re-detections are ignored, mapped areas are treated as exact, and fish are assumed uniform within a cell.
- Cells with no labels get posterior mass from the geometric prior, so the ruffe and pike totals are largely prior- and detectability-driven.
- The total is a lower-type estimate of the lake population: other species and unmapped habitat are excluded.

In the Lean statements, `Summary (perchC a b c d)` takes natural-number arguments meaning τ ∈ [a/4, b/4] and κ ∈ [c/20, d/20]. This encoding only lets the harness match the statements exactly; it has no scientific meaning. I have not self-approved anything; the decision is yours.

import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination
/-! SYNTHETIC survey VCS-LK-001 (not a real lake).  SUPPLIED: camera labels per species x habitat x size
bin (perchC ..), footprints/areas (gL, AL ..), calibration hits/80 as intervals.  ASSUMED (details in report.txt):
(1) perch, roach, ruffe, pike are PRESENT (probability 1, reviewer option b); other species are not assessed and
are not in any total.  (2) cells independent; N ~ Geometric(rho) (Gamma(1)-Poisson), rho = 1/(1+kappa A),
kappa in [c,d]/20 fish/m2 (unidentified).  (3) each fish labelled with probability p = g*tau*d (g = 6*footprint/area;
tau in [a,b]/4 = field/reference transfer, unidentified; d = calibrated detection, outward-rounded Wilson interval);
two passes pooled; camera false labels and area error ignored.  PROVED: cell_posterior (Bayes: posterior = y +
NegBin), lawOf_law (total = convolution, moments add), answer_*: for EVERY p, rho in the box the species and
total laws are probability laws, mean in [Lb,Ub], variance <= Vb, no mass below the label count.  Arguments
(a b c d) of perchC .. : answer_full (1 4 1 100) tau in [1/4,1]; answer_tau1 (4 4 1 100); answer_tauhalf (2 2 1 100);
answer_tauquarter (1 1 1 100); kappa in [1/20,5] throughout. -/
open Finset
theorem hock (k m : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), (((i + k).choose k : ℕ) : ℝ) = (((m + k + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    have h : (m + 1 + k + 1).choose (k + 1) = (m + k + 1).choose k + (m + k + 1).choose (k + 1) := by
      rw [show m + 1 + k + 1 = (m + k + 1) + 1 by ring, Nat.choose_succ_succ]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, h, show m + 1 + k = m + k + 1 by ring]
    push_cast; ring
theorem negbin {r : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ r) (h1 : r < 1) : ∀ k : ℕ,
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (((m + k).choose k : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ m) (((1 - r)⁻¹) ^ (k + 1))
  | 0 => by simpa using hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one h0 h1
  | k + 1 => by
    have hk := negbin h0 h1 k
    have hg := hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one h0 h1
    have s1 : Summable fun m : ℕ => ‖(((m + k).choose k : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ m‖ :=
      hk.summable.congr (fun m => by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)])
    have s2 : Summable fun m : ℕ => ‖r ^ m‖ :=
      hg.summable.congr (fun m => by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)])
    have hp := tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal_of_summable_norm s1 s2
    have hH := (summable_norm_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_norm s1 s2).of_norm.hasSum
    rw [hk.tsum_eq, hg.tsum_eq] at hp
    rw [← hp] at hH
    convert hH using 1
    · funext n
      rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
        (fun i j => (((i + k).choose k : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ i * r ^ j)]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun i => (((i + k).choose k : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ n) (fun i hi => by
        rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))]),
        ← Finset.sum_mul, hock k n]
      rfl
    · exact pow_succ _ _
def nu (k : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ := (((m + k).choose k : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ m * (1 - r) ^ (k + 1)
theorem nu_one {r : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ r) (h1 : r < 1) (k : ℕ) : HasSum (nu k r) 1 := by
  have := (negbin h0 h1 k).mul_right ((1 - r) ^ (k + 1))
  rw [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by linarith : (1 - r) ≠ 0), one_pow] at this
  exact this
theorem nu_id1 (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 1) (k m : ℕ) :
    ((m : ℝ) + k + 1) * nu k r m = ((k : ℝ) + 1) / (1 - r) * nu (k + 1) r m := by
  have h : (m + k + 1) * (m + k).choose k = (m + k + 1).choose (k + 1) * (k + 1) :=
    Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (m + k) k
  have h' := congrArg (fun x : ℕ => (x : ℝ)) h
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h'
  have hd : (1 - r) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hr)
  unfold nu
  show _ = _ / _ * ((((m + k + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * r ^ m * (1 - r) ^ (k + 1 + 1))
  field_simp
  linear_combination (r ^ m * (1 - r) ^ (k + 1) * (1 - r)) * h'
theorem nu_id2 (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 1) (k m : ℕ) :
    ((m : ℝ) + k + 1) * ((m : ℝ) + k + 2) * nu k r m
      = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2) / (1 - r) ^ 2 * nu (k + 2) r m := by
  have a := nu_id1 r hr k m
  have b := nu_id1 r hr (k + 1) m
  have hd : (1 - r) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hr)
  push_cast at b
  have e : (m : ℝ) + (k + 1) + 1 = (m : ℝ) + k + 2 := by ring
  rw [e] at b
  calc _ = ((m : ℝ) + k + 2) * (((m : ℝ) + k + 1) * nu k r m) := by ring
    _ = ((m : ℝ) + k + 2) * (((k : ℝ) + 1) / (1 - r) * nu (k + 1) r m) := by rw [a]
    _ = ((k : ℝ) + 1) / (1 - r) * (((m : ℝ) + k + 2) * nu (k + 1) r m) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [b]; field_simp; ring
structure Law (w : ℕ → ℝ) (m1 m2 : ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ w n
  total : HasSum w 1
  first : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * w n) m1
  second : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * w n) m2
theorem nb_law {r : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ r) (h1 : r < 1) (k : ℕ) :
    Law (nu k r) (((k : ℝ) + 1) * r / (1 - r))
      (((k : ℝ) + 1) * r / (1 - r) ^ 2 + (((k : ℝ) + 1) * r / (1 - r)) ^ 2) := by
  have hr : r ≠ 1 := by linarith
  have hd : (1 - r) ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hr; linarith
  have t0 := nu_one h0 h1 k
  have t1 := (nu_one h0 h1 (k + 1)).mul_left (((k : ℝ) + 1) / (1 - r))
  have t2 := (nu_one h0 h1 (k + 2)).mul_left (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2) / (1 - r) ^ 2)
  have f1 := t1.sub (t0.mul_left ((k : ℝ) + 1))
  have f2 := (t2.sub (f1.mul_left (2 * (k : ℝ) + 3))).sub (t0.mul_left (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2)))
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, t0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold nu; have : 0 < 1 - r := by linarith
    positivity
  · convert f1 using 1
    · funext m; linear_combination nu_id1 r hr k m
    · field_simp; ring
  · convert f2 using 1
    · funext m
      have a := nu_id2 r hr k m
      have b := nu_id1 r hr k m
      linear_combination a - (2 * (k : ℝ) + 3) * b
    · field_simp; ring
def sh (s : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if s ≤ n then g (n - s) else 0
theorem hasSum_sh {g : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (h : HasSum g a) (s : ℕ) : HasSum (sh s g) a := by
  rw [← hasSum_nat_add_iff' s]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => by simp [sh, show ¬ s ≤ i by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega]),
    sub_zero]
  convert h using 1
  funext n; simp [sh]
theorem law_shift {w : ℕ → ℝ} {m1 m2 : ℝ} (h : Law w m1 m2) (s : ℕ) :
    Law (sh s w) (m1 + s) (m2 + 2 * s * m1 + (s : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, s ≤ n → ((n : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((n - s : ℕ) : ℝ) + s := fun n hn => by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hn]; ring
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, hasSum_sh h.total s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold sh; split_ifs
    · exact h.nonneg _
    · exact le_refl _
  · convert hasSum_sh (h.first.add (h.total.mul_left (s : ℝ))) s using 1
    · funext n; unfold sh
      split_ifs with hn
      · rw [key n hn]; ring
      · simp
    · ring
  · convert hasSum_sh ((h.second.add (h.first.mul_left (2 * (s : ℝ)))).add
      (h.total.mul_left ((s : ℝ) ^ 2))) s using 1
    · funext n; unfold sh
      split_ifs with hn
      · rw [key n hn]; ring
      · simp
    · ring
def cv (f g : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ kl ∈ antidiagonal t, f kl.1 * g kl.2
theorem cv_hasSum {f g : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ g n) {A B : ℝ}
    (hA : HasSum f A) (hB : HasSum g B) : HasSum (cv f g) (A * B) := by
  have s1 : Summable fun m => ‖f m‖ := hA.summable.congr (fun m => by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hf m)])
  have s2 : Summable fun m => ‖g m‖ := hB.summable.congr (fun m => by rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hg m)])
  have hp := tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal_of_summable_norm s1 s2
  rw [hA.tsum_eq, hB.tsum_eq] at hp
  rw [hp]
  exact (summable_norm_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_norm s1 s2).of_norm.hasSum
theorem law_conv {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {ma sa mb sb : ℝ} (ha : Law a ma sa) (hb : Law b mb sb) :
    Law (cv a b) (ma + mb) (sa + 2 * ma * mb + sb) := by
  have na := ha.nonneg
  have nb := hb.nonneg
  have nA : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * a n := fun n => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (na n)
  have nB : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * b n := fun n => mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (nb n)
  have nA2 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * a n := fun n => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (na n)
  have nB2 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * b n := fun n => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (nb n)
  have key : ∀ (t : ℕ) (kl : ℕ × ℕ), kl ∈ antidiagonal t → (t : ℝ) = (kl.1 : ℝ) + (kl.2 : ℝ) :=
    fun t kl hkl => by rw [← Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hkl]; push_cast; ring
  refine ⟨fun t => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun kl _ => mul_nonneg (na _) (nb _)), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using cv_hasSum na nb ha.total hb.total
  · convert (cv_hasSum nA nb ha.first hb.total).add (cv_hasSum na nB ha.total hb.first) using 1
    · funext t
      unfold cv
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun kl hkl => by rw [key t kl hkl]; ring)
    · ring
  · convert ((cv_hasSum nA2 nb ha.second hb.total).add
      ((cv_hasSum nA nB ha.first hb.first).mul_left 2)).add (cv_hasSum na nB2 ha.total hb.second) using 1
    · funext t
      unfold cv
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun kl hkl => by rw [key t kl hkl]; ring)
    · ring
def delta0 (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if n = 0 then 1 else 0
theorem delta0_law : Law delta0 0 0 := by
  have h := hasSum_ite_eq 0 (1 : ℝ)
  have h0 := hasSum_ite_eq 0 (0 : ℝ)
  refine ⟨fun n => ?_, h, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold delta0; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · convert h0 using 1; funext n; unfold delta0; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
  · convert h0 using 1; funext n; unfold delta0; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
/-! ## One cell: Bayes' rule -/
-- prior N ~ Geometric(rho); lik = Binomial(n,p) pmf at y; post = Bayes' rule
def prior (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := ρ * (1 - ρ) ^ n
def lik (p : ℝ) (y n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n.choose y : ℝ) * p ^ y * (1 - p) ^ (n - y)
def unorm (y : ℕ) (p ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := prior ρ n * lik p y n
noncomputable def post (y : ℕ) (p ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := unorm y p ρ n / ∑' m, unorm y p ρ m
theorem unorm_below {y : ℕ} (p ρ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (h : n < y) : unorm y p ρ n = 0 := by
  unfold unorm lik; rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt h]; simp
theorem unorm_hasSum {y : ℕ} {p ρ : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) :
    HasSum (unorm y p ρ) (ρ * ((1 - ρ) * p) ^ y * ((1 - (1 - ρ) * (1 - p))⁻¹) ^ (y + 1)) := by
  have h1 : 0 < 1 - ρ := by linarith
  have h2 : 0 < 1 - p := by linarith
  have h := (negbin (by positivity : 0 ≤ (1 - ρ) * (1 - p)) (by nlinarith) y).mul_left (ρ * ((1 - ρ) * p) ^ y)
  rw [← hasSum_nat_add_iff' y, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => unorm_below p ρ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)),
    sub_zero]
  convert h using 1
  funext m
  unfold unorm prior lik
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_add, mul_pow, mul_pow]
  ring
noncomputable def meanR (y : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ := ((y : ℝ) + 1) * r / (1 - r) + y
noncomputable def varR (y : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ := ((y : ℝ) + 1) * r / (1 - r) ^ 2
/-- **Cell posterior.** `N | y` is `y +` NegBin(shape `y+1`, ratio `r = (1-ρ)(1-p)`): a probability
law with mean `(y+1)r/(1-r)+y` and variance `(y+1)r/(1-r)²`. -/
theorem cell_post_law {y : ℕ} {p ρ : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) :
    Law (post y p ρ) (meanR y ((1 - ρ) * (1 - p)))
      (varR y ((1 - ρ) * (1 - p)) + meanR y ((1 - ρ) * (1 - p)) ^ 2) := by
  have h1 : 0 < 1 - ρ := by linarith
  have h2 : 0 < 1 - p := by linarith
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ (1 - ρ) * (1 - p) := by positivity
  have hr1 : (1 - ρ) * (1 - p) < 1 := by nlinarith
  have heq : post y p ρ = sh y (nu y ((1 - ρ) * (1 - p))) := by
    funext n
    unfold post sh
    rw [(unorm_hasSum hp0 hp1 hρ0 hρ1).tsum_eq]
    split_ifs with hn
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      have hd : 1 - (1 - ρ) * (1 - p) ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have hz : ρ * ((1 - ρ) * p) ^ y ≠ 0 := by positivity
      unfold unorm prior lik nu
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, inv_pow, pow_add, mul_pow, mul_pow]
      field_simp
    · rw [unorm_below p ρ (by omega)]; simp
  rw [heq]
  convert law_shift (nb_law hr0 hr1 y) y using 1
  · unfold meanR; ring
  · unfold meanR varR; ring
theorem cell_posterior : ∀ (y : ℕ) (p ρ : ℝ), 0 < p → p < 1 → 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 →
    Law (post y p ρ) (meanR y ((1 - ρ) * (1 - p))) (varR y ((1 - ρ) * (1 - p)) + meanR y ((1 - ρ) * (1 - p)) ^ 2) :=
  fun _ _ _ a b c d => cell_post_law a b c d

theorem post_below {y : ℕ} (p ρ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (h : n < y) : post y p ρ n = 0 := by
  unfold post; rw [unorm_below p ρ h]; simp
/-! ## Independent cells and their total -/
structure Fit where
  y : ℕ
  p : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
def FitOk (f : Fit) : Prop := 0 < f.p ∧ f.p < 1 ∧ 0 < f.ρ ∧ f.ρ < 1
def rr (f : Fit) : ℝ := (1 - f.ρ) * (1 - f.p)
theorem cell_law (f : Fit) (h : FitOk f) :
    Law (post f.y f.p f.ρ) (meanR f.y (rr f)) (varR f.y (rr f) + meanR f.y (rr f) ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ := h
  exact cell_post_law a b c d
noncomputable def lawOf : List Fit → ℕ → ℝ
  | [] => delta0
  | f :: fs => cv (post f.y f.p f.ρ) (lawOf fs)
noncomputable def M1 (l : List Fit) : ℝ := (l.map (fun f => meanR f.y (rr f))).sum
noncomputable def V (l : List Fit) : ℝ := (l.map (fun f => varR f.y (rr f))).sum
def Ysum (l : List Fit) : ℕ := (l.map (fun f => f.y)).sum
theorem lawOf_law : ∀ l : List Fit, (∀ f ∈ l, FitOk f) → Law (lawOf l) (M1 l) (V l + M1 l ^ 2)
  | [], _ => by simpa [lawOf, M1, V] using delta0_law
  | f :: fs, h => by
    have := law_conv (cell_law f (h f (List.mem_cons_self ..)))
      (lawOf_law fs (fun g hg => h g (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hg)))
    simp only [lawOf, M1, V, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at this ⊢
    convert this using 1; ring
theorem lawOf_below : ∀ (l : List Fit), (∀ f ∈ l, FitOk f) → ∀ n, n < Ysum l → lawOf l n = 0
  | [], _, n, hn => by simp [Ysum] at hn
  | f :: fs, h, n, hn => by
    have ih := lawOf_below fs (fun g hg => h g (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hg))
    have hy : Ysum (f :: fs) = f.y + Ysum fs := by simp [Ysum]
    simp only [lawOf, cv]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun kl hkl => ?_)
    have hs := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hkl
    by_cases h1 : kl.1 < f.y
    · rw [post_below _ _ h1, zero_mul]
    · rw [ih kl.2 (by omega), mul_zero]
theorem meanR_mono (y : ℕ) {r s : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ r) (h : r ≤ s) (h2 : s < 1) :
    meanR y r ≤ meanR y s ∧ varR y r ≤ varR y s := by
  have a : 0 < 1 - r := by linarith
  have b : 0 < 1 - s := by linarith
  have hy : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  unfold meanR varR
  constructor
  · have : r / (1 - r) ≤ s / (1 - s) := by rw [div_le_div_iff₀ a b]; nlinarith
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hy
    rw [mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc]; linarith
  · have : r / (1 - r) ^ 2 ≤ s / (1 - s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h) (sub_nonneg.mpr (show r * s ≤ 1 by nlinarith))]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hy
    rw [mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc]; linarith
/-- A scenario cell: `y` labels; the labelling probability lies in `[plo,phi]` and the prior ratio
in `[qlo,qhi]`. -/
structure Cell where
  y : ℕ
  plo : ℝ
  phi : ℝ
  qlo : ℝ
  qhi : ℝ
def CellOk (c : Cell) : Prop := 0 < c.plo ∧ c.plo ≤ c.phi ∧ c.phi < 1 ∧ 0 < c.qlo ∧ c.qlo ≤ c.qhi ∧ c.qhi < 1
/-- `P c`, `Q c` are the (unknown) labelling probability and prior ratio of each cell. -/
def Within (cs : List Cell) (P Q : Cell → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ c ∈ cs, c.plo ≤ P c ∧ P c ≤ c.phi ∧ c.qlo ≤ Q c ∧ Q c ≤ c.qhi
def fits (cs : List Cell) (P Q : Cell → ℝ) : List Fit := cs.map (fun c => ⟨c.y, P c, Q c⟩)
noncomputable def rLo (c : Cell) : ℝ := (1 - c.qhi) * (1 - c.phi)
noncomputable def rHi (c : Cell) : ℝ := (1 - c.qlo) * (1 - c.plo)
/-- Posterior summary of the total of the cells `cs` for every admissible `P`, `Q`: the total law is a
probability law (mean `M1`, variance `V`); `M1 ∈ [Lb,Ub]`, `V ≤ Vb`; no mass below the label count. -/
def Summary (cs : List Cell) (Lb Ub Vb : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ P Q : Cell → ℝ, Within cs P Q →
  Law (lawOf (fits cs P Q)) (M1 (fits cs P Q)) (V (fits cs P Q) + M1 (fits cs P Q) ^ 2) ∧
  (Lb : ℝ) ≤ M1 (fits cs P Q) ∧ M1 (fits cs P Q) ≤ Ub ∧ V (fits cs P Q) ≤ Vb ∧
  ∀ n : ℕ, n < (cs.map (fun c => c.y)).sum → lawOf (fits cs P Q) n = 0
theorem summary_of_box : ∀ (cs : List Cell), (∀ c ∈ cs, CellOk c) → ∀ {Lb Ub Vb : ℕ},
    (Lb : ℝ) ≤ (cs.map (fun c => meanR c.y (rLo c))).sum → (cs.map (fun c => meanR c.y (rHi c))).sum ≤ Ub →
    (cs.map (fun c => varR c.y (rHi c))).sum ≤ Vb → Summary cs Lb Ub Vb := by
  suffices H : ∀ (cs : List Cell), (∀ c ∈ cs, CellOk c) → ∀ P Q : Cell → ℝ, Within cs P Q →
      (∀ f ∈ fits cs P Q, FitOk f) ∧ (cs.map (fun c => meanR c.y (rLo c))).sum ≤ M1 (fits cs P Q) ∧
      M1 (fits cs P Q) ≤ (cs.map (fun c => meanR c.y (rHi c))).sum ∧
      V (fits cs P Q) ≤ (cs.map (fun c => varR c.y (rHi c))).sum ∧
      Ysum (fits cs P Q) = (cs.map (fun c => c.y)).sum by
    intro cs hok Lb Ub Vb h1 h2 h3 P Q hw
    obtain ⟨ok, a, b, c, d⟩ := H cs hok P Q hw
    exact ⟨lawOf_law _ ok, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, fun n hn =>
      lawOf_below _ ok n (by rw [d]; exact hn)⟩
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro _ P Q _; simp [fits, M1, V, Ysum]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    intro hok P Q hw
    obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, i4, i5⟩ := ih (fun x hx => hok x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)) P Q
      (fun x hx => hw x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
    obtain ⟨hp0, hpp, hp1, hq0, hqq, hq1⟩ := hok c (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    obtain ⟨w1, w2, w3, w4⟩ := hw c (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have g1 : 0 < 1 - P c := by linarith
    have g2 : 0 < 1 - Q c := by linarith
    have f1 : 0 ≤ rLo c := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have f2 : rLo c ≤ (1 - Q c) * (1 - P c) := mul_le_mul (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) g2.le
    have f3 : (1 - Q c) * (1 - P c) ≤ rHi c := mul_le_mul (by linarith) (by linarith) g1.le (by linarith)
    have f4 : rHi c < 1 := by unfold rHi; nlinarith [mul_pos (by linarith : 0 < 1 - c.qlo) (by linarith : 0 < 1 - c.plo)]
    have m1 := meanR_mono c.y f1 f2 (by linarith)
    have m2 := meanR_mono c.y (by positivity) f3 f4
    have e : M1 (fits (c :: cs) P Q) = meanR c.y ((1 - Q c) * (1 - P c)) + M1 (fits cs P Q) := by
      simp [fits, M1, rr]
    have e' : V (fits (c :: cs) P Q) = varR c.y ((1 - Q c) * (1 - P c)) + V (fits cs P Q) := by
      simp [fits, V, rr]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro f hf
      simp only [fits, List.map_cons, List.mem_cons] at hf
      rcases hf with rfl | hf
      · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · exact i1 f (by simpa [fits] using hf)
    · simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]; rw [e]; linarith [m1.1]
    · simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]; rw [e]; linarith [m2.1]
    · simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]; rw [e']; linarith [m2.2]
    · have : Ysum (fits (c :: cs) P Q) = c.y + Ysum (fits cs P Q) := by simp [Ysum, fits]
      rw [this, i5]; simp
/-! ## The lake (SYNTHETIC survey VCS-LK-001) -/
noncomputable def gL : ℝ := 72000/1731023
noncomputable def AL : ℝ := 1731023/100
noncomputable def gO : ℝ := 21600/581003

/-- Cell with `p ∈ [g·a·l, g·b·h]` (g = 6·footprint/area, τ ∈ [a,b]/4 = transfer, `[l,h]` = calibrated
detection d) and prior ratio `1/(1+κA)`, `κ ∈ [c,d]/20` fish/m². -/
noncomputable def mkC (a b c d : ℕ) (g A l h : ℝ) (y : ℕ) : Cell :=
  ⟨y, g * (a / 4) * l, g * (b / 4) * h, 1 / (1 + (d / 20) * A), 1 / (1 + (c / 20) * A)⟩
noncomputable def sp (a b c d : ℕ) (y1 y2 y3 y4 y5 y6 : ℕ) (u1 u2 v1 v2 : ℝ) : List Cell :=
  [mkC a b c d gL AL u1 u2 y1, mkC a b c d gL AL v1 v2 y2, mkC a b c d gO AO u1 u2 y3,
   mkC a b c d gO AO v1 v2 y4, mkC a b c d gD AD u1 u2 y5, mkC a b c d gD AD v1 v2 y6]
noncomputable def perchC (a b c d : ℕ) : List Cell := sp a b c d 9 13 1 11 2 3 (27/100) (49/100) (37/50) (91/100)
noncomputable def roachC (a b c d : ℕ) : List Cell := sp a b c d 8 8 1 5 3 1 (6/25) (9/20) (57/100) (39/50)
noncomputable def ruffeC (a b c d : ℕ) : List Cell := sp a b c d 0 0 1 0 0 0 (1/20) (19/100) (17/100) (37/100)
noncomputable def pikeC (a b c d : ℕ) : List Cell := sp a b c d 0 0 1 0 0 0 (9/50) (39/100) (9/20) (67/100)
noncomputable def lakeC (a b c d : ℕ) : List Cell := perchC a b c d ++ roachC a b c d ++ ruffeC a b c d ++ pikeC a b c d
theorem answer_full :
    Summary (perchC 1 4 1 100) 1431 8941 2247795 ∧
    Summary (roachC 1 4 1 100) 1205 8400 2593063 ∧
    Summary (ruffeC 1 4 1 100) 605 8922 14916093 ∧
    Summary (pikeC 1 4 1 100) 317 2659 1233022 ∧

  refine ⟨summary_of_box _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_, summary_of_box _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_, summary_of_box _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_, summary_of_box _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_, summary_of_box _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_⟩
  all_goals norm_num [perchC, roachC, ruffeC, pikeC, lakeC, sp, mkC, CellOk, rLo, rHi, meanR, varR, gL, AL, gO, AO, gD, AD]

  all_goals norm_num [perchC, roachC, ruffeC, pikeC, lakeC, sp, mkC, CellOk, rLo, rHi, meanR, varR, gL, AL, gO, AO, gD, AD]

  all_goals norm_num [perchC, roachC, ruffeC, pikeC, lakeC, sp, mkC, CellOk, rLo, rHi, meanR, varR, gL, AL, gO, AO, gD, AD]

open Finset
structure Law (w : ℕ → ℝ) (m1 m2 : ℝ) : Prop where
  nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ w n
  total : HasSum w 1
  first : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * w n) m1
  second : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * w n) m2

def cv (f g : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ kl ∈ antidiagonal t, f kl.1 * g kl.2

def delta0 (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if n = 0 then 1 else 0

def prior (ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := ρ * (1 - ρ) ^ n

def lik (p : ℝ) (y n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n.choose y : ℝ) * p ^ y * (1 - p) ^ (n - y)

def unorm (y : ℕ) (p ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := prior ρ n * lik p y n

noncomputable def post (y : ℕ) (p ρ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := unorm y p ρ n / ∑' m, unorm y p ρ m

noncomputable def meanR (y : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ := ((y : ℝ) + 1) * r / (1 - r) + y

noncomputable def varR (y : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ := ((y : ℝ) + 1) * r / (1 - r) ^ 2

structure Fit where
  y : ℕ
  p : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ

def rr (f : Fit) : ℝ := (1 - f.ρ) * (1 - f.p)

noncomputable def lawOf : List Fit → ℕ → ℝ
  | [] => delta0
  | f :: fs => cv (post f.y f.p f.ρ) (lawOf fs)

noncomputable def M1 (l : List Fit) : ℝ := (l.map (fun f => meanR f.y (rr f))).sum

noncomputable def V (l : List Fit) : ℝ := (l.map (fun f => varR f.y (rr f))).sum

/-- A scenario cell: `y` labels; the labelling probability lies in `[plo,phi]` and the prior ratio
in `[qlo,qhi]`. -/

  ∀ c ∈ cs, c.plo ≤ P c ∧ P c ≤ c.phi ∧ c.qlo ≤ Q c ∧ Q c ≤ c.qhi

def fits (cs : List Cell) (P Q : Cell → ℝ) : List Fit := cs.map (fun c => ⟨c.y, P c, Q c⟩)

/-- Posterior summary of the total of the cells `cs` for every admissible `P`, `Q`: the total law is a
probability law (mean `M1`, variance `V`); `M1 ∈ [Lb,Ub]`, `V ≤ Vb`; no mass below the label count. -/
def Summary (cs : List Cell) (Lb Ub Vb : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ P Q : Cell → ℝ, Within cs P Q →
  Law (lawOf (fits cs P Q)) (M1 (fits cs P Q)) (V (fits cs P Q) + M1 (fits cs P Q) ^ 2) ∧
  (Lb : ℝ) ≤ M1 (fits cs P Q) ∧ M1 (fits cs P Q) ≤ Ub ∧ V (fits cs P Q) ≤ Vb ∧
  ∀ n : ℕ, n < (cs.map (fun c => c.y)).sum → lawOf (fits cs P Q) n = 0

/-! SYNTHETIC survey VCS-LK-001 (not a real lake).  SUPPLIED: camera labels per species x habitat x size
